text: Mũthenya wa mwambĩrĩrio, atalamu a sayansi kuma cukuru mũnene wa Stanford School of Medicine makĩanĩrĩra uhumbũro wa ithimi njerũ iria ciagayũkanagia cells kũringana na mĩthemba yacio: printable chip nini ingĩthodeko kũringana na mũtaratara wa inkjet printers na kĩndũ thendi ĩmwe ya Amerika.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Athuthuria matongoretie makiuga ũndũ ũyũ no ũteithie kũonekana mĩrĩ-inĩ tene kwa mĩrimũ ta cancer, tuberculosis, mũkingo na marĩria kurĩ arwaru kuma mabũrũri mathĩni, kũrĩa ũhoni kuma mĩrimũ ta cancer ya nyondo ĩrĩ mĩnini ĩngĩringithanio na mabũrũri matongu.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Nayo JAS 39C Gripen ĩgĩtuthuka ĩ kabara-ini kayo kĩroko mathaa ma thaa ithatũ (0230 UTC) na ĩkiuma mwaki, ũndũ watũmire airport kũhingo na kũrũgamia ũthii wa ndege cia biashara.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Mũtwari wa ndege ĩyo nĩamenyekanire ta mũtongoria Dilokrit Pattavee
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Nyũmba cia mohoro cia matũra-inĩ macio ĩkĩanĩrĩra atĩ ngaari ĩmwe ya kũhoria mwaki kĩharoinĩ kĩa ndege nĩ yagaragarire ĩkĩhũrana na mũtino ũcio.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal, ũrĩa nĩ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩrĩ na inyanya nĩathire Barca mĩthimu ĩtatũ mĩthiru kuma Sevilla.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Kuma athiĩ Catalan capital, Vidal athakire mĩthako mĩrongo ĩna na kenda ya kĩrabu kĩu.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Mandamano macio mambĩrĩirie thaa ithano (UTC+1) hau Whitewall kũng'ethanĩra na rĩingĩrĩro-inĩ rĩrĩa rĩgitĩirwo nĩ thigari nginya Downing street, gĩikaro kĩrũmu kĩa mũnene wa Ministers.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Orio thutha wa thaa ithano, andũ acio mandamanĩte makĩhingĩrĩria ngaari hau barabara ya igũrũ rĩa Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Kũrĩ thaa ithano na ndagĩka mĩrongo ĩrĩ, thigari makĩĩra arĩa mandamanĩte machoke thutha gacĩra-ini kanini, makiugaga nĩharĩ bata kũiganania kĩhoto kĩa acio mandamanĩte na athii a bara bara arĩa mathiaga o makĩongererekaga.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Kĩndũ thaa ithano na ndagĩka mĩrongo ĩrĩ na kenda, maandamano macio magĩkinya Whitehall, kũhetũka Trafalgar Square, makabĩte Strand na kũhetũka Aldwych marorete Kingsway na merekeire Kingsway kũrĩa kĩama gĩa conservative kĩarĩ na mũchemanio wao wa Spring mũkawa inĩ wa Grand Connaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Record ĩrĩa yaigĩtwo nĩ Nadal kũrĩ mũthaki wa Canada yarĩ mũgwanja kwa igĩrĩ.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Ni erĩgĩte kũhotwo nĩ Raonic magĩthaka macindano-inĩ ma Brisbane Open.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal aakĩhota point mĩrongo ĩnana na inyanya harĩ igana mĩthako inĩ ĩyo, na akĩhota point mĩrongo mũgwanja na ithathatũ serve inĩ ya mbere.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Thutha wa mũthako, mũthamaki wa Clay akiuga, "Nĩndakena mũno nĩgocekereria mũthiũrũko wa mũico wa mathako maya ma bata. Njũkĩte gũkũ kũgeria kũhotana mũthako ĩnĩ ũyũ."
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: "Maratathi ma Panama" nĩ iburi rĩa ciugo itũmĩkaga kũonania documents million iria ciarutĩtwo  kambũni ya kĩ watho ya Panama yetago Mossack Fonseca, iria ciagũire kĩmahĩtia moko-inĩ ma kambũni cia mohoro na ũkinyanĩria mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri igĩrĩ na ikũmi na ithathatũ.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Documents icio nĩcionanagia ũrĩa bengi ikũmi na inya ciateithĩrĩirie agũri acio arĩa atongũ kũhitha billion cia mbeca cia America nĩgetha matikarĩhe igoti na matikarũmĩrĩre mawatho macio mangĩ.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Ngatheti ĩmwe ya Uingeretha, The Guardian, ĩroigire  bengi ya Deutsche nĩyo yatũmĩkaga gũtigĩrĩra gacunjĩ ga ithatũ ga kambũni ngiri ĩmwe na magana merĩ cia Shell nĩ ciahotekithia wendi ũcio.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Nĩ kwagĩire na maandamano maingĩ thĩ yothe, na aganu aingĩ magĩcirithio, na atongoria a thirikari cia Iceland na pakistan maratiga wĩra.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Ma ũrĩa waciarĩirwo Hong Kong, athomeire New York University na Harvard Law School na gwĩ kahinda ahetwo "Green Card" ĩrĩa yamũhotithagia gũtuĩka mũraiya mũikari wa America.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh nĩtaonanirie atĩ hĩndĩ ya ithurano Ma no ore bũrũri ihinda ria ngahĩha icio.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh noonanirie atĩ photogenic Ma nĩ mũndũ mũno wa style kũrĩ substance.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Ona thengia wa maũndũ macio ma kũigĩrĩrwo, Ma nĩacindire nĩũndũ wakũonania ũnyitanĩri mũnene na Chinese Mainland.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Mũthaki wa mũthenya wa ũmũthĩ nĩ Alex Ovechkin wa Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Arĩ na mbao igĩrĩ na agĩteithĩrĩria kũingĩria ingĩ igĩrĩ rĩrĩa team ya Washington yahotanire na mbao ithano gwa ithatũ magĩthaka na Atlanta Thrashers.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Ovechkin ateithĩrĩirie team yake kũfunga mbao riita rĩa mbere ũtukũ ũcio hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mbao ya Rookie Nicklas Backstrom yamaheire ũhotani.
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: Mbao yake ya keerĩ ya ũtukũ ĩrarĩ ya mĩrongo ĩtandatũ ya mũthimu ũcio, na agĩtuĩka mũthaki wa mbere kũingĩria mbao mĩrongo ĩtandatũ kana makĩria mũthimu ũmwe kuma 1995-1966, rĩrĩa Jaromir Lemieux na Mario Lemieux marakinyirie ũhotani ta ũcio.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten nĩatarĩtwo arĩ wa igana rĩmwe rĩa mĩrongo kenda harĩ andũ magana mana arĩa atongu mũno Amerika mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na inyanya, akĩrĩkana arĩ na ũtonga wa dora billion igĩrĩ gaturumo ithatũ.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Aigĩrĩirwo thũmbĩ ya mathomo kuma college ya Arts na Science thukuru mũnene wa Virginia mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo ĩtano na nĩarĩ mũheani wa ũteithio mũnene thukuru ũcio.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Njera ya Iraq, Ghraib prison, nĩ yacinirwo hĩndĩ ya maandamano.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Njera ya Iraq, Ghraib prison, nĩ  'ĩracinirwo' hĩndĩ ya maandamano.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr ahotire gĩcindano-inĩ kĩa Singapore Grand Prix kĩa mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na inyanya thuutha wa kũrũgama kwa Fernando Alonso, urĩa warehaga ngaari ya kũĩgitĩra ũgwati.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Na rĩrĩa ngaari cia macindano iria ciarĩ mbere ya Alonso ciathire kũnyua maguta harĩ ũmenyereri-inĩ, agĩthiĩ mbele na akĩoya ũhotani.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. nĩabutiro thutha wa macindano ma mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na kenda ma Grand Prix Hungary.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Thaa ithatũ itigĩtie dagĩka ikũmi na inya orĩo, taũni ng'ima kũrakira, kũonania kahinda karĩa jeti ya bere ĩraringire itanya rĩayo.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Mĩrũri ĩrĩ ya ũtheri yamũrĩkithĩtio ĩroretio na igũrũ ũtũkũ ũcio.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Waki no ũrathiĩ na mbere wa skyscrapers ithano njerũ mwako-inĩ, na handũ ha ũkui na Memorial park gatagati-inĩ.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Kĩbindi kĩa PBS kĩna ngerenwa cia Emmy itanyihĩire mirongo ĩrĩ na inya, na nĩ gĩkuhĩ kurĩ Saseme Street na Mister Roger's Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: O kihingo gia kĩbindi kĩu nĩkĩahinyagĩrĩria ũndũ ũmwe ibukuinĩ rĩmwe na gĩkatabania ũhoro ũcio na ng'ano nyingĩ.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Kĩbindi nokiaheaga ciana mwerekera wa mabuku marĩa cigwetha na cithome rĩrĩa ciathiĩ library.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, kuuma WNED Buffalo (kĩhumo kĩa Reading Rainbow) augire "Reading Rainbow yathomithagia ciana gĩtumi gĩa gũthoma,... wendo wa gũthoma -[kĩbindi kĩu] kĩendithagĩrĩa ciana kuoya ibuku na kũrĩthoma.
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Hamwe na John Grant, amwe metĩkĩtie atĩ ũnyihu wa mĩcara na ũgarũrũku wa mwĩcirĩrie wa gĩthomo kĩa tafaarĩra nĩgĩcangĩire gũthira kwa kĩbindi kĩu.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Nakĩo kihuhũkanio kĩu kĩa rũhuho kĩrĩa kĩarĩ mairo magana matandatũ ma mĩrongo ĩna na ithano mwena wa ithuiro wa Cape Verde islands, kĩerĩkanaga gĩgũthira mbere ya gũkinyĩra na kwananga thĩ nyũmũ, atalaamu a rĩera kuga.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred kahinda gaka ĩna huho irathiĩ na ihenya rĩa mairo igana rĩa ithano harĩ ithaa na rĩerekeire mwena wa ithũĩro rĩa rũgongo.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred nĩkĩo kĩhuhũkanio kĩrĩa kĩa hinya mũno gĩa tropical cyclone kĩrĩa kĩanandĩkwo mwena wa rũgũrũ na irathĩro wa Atlantic kuuma rĩrĩa mbica cia satelite cĩathodekirwo, na no gachunjĩ ga ithatũ gia huhũkanio nene kanandĩko mwena wa irathĩro rĩa 35°W.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Kurĩ mweri mĩrongo ĩrĩ na inya mwaka wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana mũgwanja ma mĩrongo ĩtano na kenda, Arthur Guiness agĩkĩra kĩrore ũiguithanio wa ũkobori wa St James' Gate Brewery kuria Dublin, Ireland.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Mĩaka magana merĩ ma mĩrongo ĩtano mĩhetũku, Guiness nĩ yakũrĩte ta biashara nene thĩ yothe, na wendia wakinyĩte billion ikũmi cia Europe kana billion ikũmi na inya cia Amerika o mwaka.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: John Reid, mũteithania wa ũtwari wa A1GP timu ya New Zealand, ũmũthĩ nĩ aigire rũgano nĩũndũ wa gũtwarithia ihenya inene mũno harĩ miaka mirongo ĩna na inyanya Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, gũtarĩ kuna watho.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Mr Reid nĩ ahotire gũtwarithia AIGP ya New Zealand, Black Beauty harĩ ihenya rĩa kilometer igana rĩmwe rĩa mĩrongo ĩtandatũ o harĩ ithaa maita mũgwanja igũrũ rĩa ndaraca.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Nacio thigari cia New Zealand ciarĩ na thĩna gũtũmĩra speed radar guns ĩria yonanagia ihenya rĩrĩa rĩathiagwo nĩ Mr Reid nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa Black Beauty ĩrĩ thĩ, na kahinda karĩa Mr Reid athire kahora thĩ wa ihenya rĩa kilometer igana rĩmwe rĩa mĩrongo ĩtandatũ harĩ ithaa norĩo mahotire kũmũtarĩra dagĩka.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Harĩ mĩeri ĩtatũ mĩhetũku, makĩria ma anyitwo mĩrongo ĩnana nĩmarekereirio kuma Central Booking facility gũtarĩ gũcirithio.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Mweri wa kana mwaka ũyũ, watho nĩ waheanirwo nĩ mũcirithania Glynn wa kũgiria jera ĩyo kũrekereria arĩa manyitĩtwo makĩria ya mathaa mĩrongo ĩrĩ  na ĩna kuuma manyitwo na arĩa matathikĩrĩirio nĩ wakiri mũthuure nĩ igoti.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Commissioner aheanaga bail, ĩrĩa ĩngĩaheanirwo yatũmĩkaga kwandĩkithia ciira ũrĩa wandĩkĩtwo nĩ mũthirikari ũrĩa wanyitanĩte. Ciira ũcio nĩwekĩragwo mĩtambo-inĩ ya computer kũrĩa yateithagĩrĩria kũrũmĩrĩra ũrĩa ũrathiĩ na mbere.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Mũthenya wa gũthikĩrĩria ciira no wonanagia wendi wa kũhe mwĩkũĩro kĩhoto kĩa igeria rĩa naĩhenya.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, mũigi kĩgĩna wa Australia na mũndũ ũrĩa warĩ na kanya kanene kũoya ũtongoria kuma kũrĩ mũnene wa ministers John Howard eta mũtongoria wa kĩama kĩa Liberal nĩaheanire ũnyitĩrĩri wake harĩ itua rĩa gũthondeka kĩganda kĩa hinya wa nuclear Australia.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Mr Costello nĩ augire atĩ rĩrĩa ũthondeki wa hinya wa nuclear ũgatuĩka mwega wonjoria-inĩ, Australia nĩyagĩrĩirwo ĩthiĩ na mbere na kũũtũmĩra.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "ũngĩgatuika wa ũhũri wa biacara, nĩtwagĩrĩirwo nĩ gũkorwo naguo. ũguo nĩ kuuga, hatirĩ gĩtũmi kĩa kĩgirĩrĩria kĩa hinya ũcio wa nuclear" Mr Costello akiuga.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Kũringana na Ansa, " bolithi nĩ cieciragia na makamakio nĩ njũragano nyingĩ iria metigagĩra no itumũre haro nene ya ũtongoria.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Thigari makiuga Lo Piccolo nĩarĩ na guoko kwa igũrũ tondũ nĩarĩ mũruti wa wĩra wa guoko kwa ũrĩo wa Provenzano kũrĩa Palermo, na experience nĩyamũheithĩtĩe gĩtĩo kĩa arĩa akũrũ na anene arĩa meĩtanagia na mũtaratara wa Provenzano, wa kwĩhĩtha thĩ o ũrĩa kungĩhoteteka nginya network yao ĩgĩe hinya.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Anene acio matongoretio nĩ Provenzano kuma o rĩrĩa aninire haaro ĩrĩa yatongoretio nĩ Riina ĩkĩng'ethanĩra na thirikari ĩrĩa yoragire augĩrĩria a mafia Giovanni Falcone na Paolo Borsellino mwaka-inĩ wa 1992.
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: CEO wa Apple Steve Jobs akĩrugũria mũtabo rĩrĩa aumĩrire stage na akĩruta thimũ ya iPhone kuma mũhuko wake wa jeans.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Kahinda-inĩ ga mĩario yake ya mathaa merĩ nĩaugire atĩ, " ũmũthi Apple nĩ ĩgũthiĩ na mbere na gũthondeka thiimũ werũ, nĩ tũgũthodeka rũgano ũmũthĩ".
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Brazil nĩguo bũrũri ũrĩa mũnene ũrũmagĩrĩra Roman Catholic thĩ yothe, na Kanitha wa Roman Catholic nĩ ũkoretwo ũgĩkinyĩrĩria ũregani harĩ gwĩtĩkĩrio gwa kĩ watho kũhikania andu aa muhiriga umwe
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Nayo National Congress ya Brazil nĩ ũcirĩire gwĩtĩkĩrio gwa kĩ watho mĩaka ikũmi, na ihiko icio cia mũingĩ ciĩtikĩrĩtio kĩwatho o Rio Grande do Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Watho mwerũ ũtahetũkĩtio wathodekirwo nĩ Mayor wa tene wa Sao Paulo, Marta Suplicy. Watho ũcio wendĩkithĩtio, thutha wa gũthodekwo, rĩu wĩ moko-inĩ ma Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Arũrũngani mehokete kũngania irore million ĩmwe gaturumo igĩrĩ  matware National Congress mweri wa ikũmi na ũmwe.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Thuutha wa kũmenyeka atĨ bamiri nyingĨ nĨciacaragia ũteithio wa kĨ-watho kũgirĨrĨria kũingatwo, nĨkwarĨ na mũcemanio ũrĨa warĨ mweri 20 wa gatatũ kũrĨa East Bay Community Center nĨundũ wa arĨa mahutĨtio nĨ wĨici wa nyũmba.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: HĨndĨ ĨrĨa akombori maambirĨirie kwĨrana marĨa mamakorete, bamirĨ nyingĨ iria ciahutĨtio o-rĨmwe ikĨmeya atĨ Carolyn Wilson nĨaiyĨte mbeca ciao irĨa maigithĨtie na akĨũra taũni.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Akombori a Lockwood Gardens meetĨkĨtie atĨ nĨ kwarĨ na bamĨrĨ ingĨ 40 kana makĨria iria ciarĨ ũgwati-inĨ wa kũingatwo, ũũ nĨ kumania na kumenya atĨ borithi a OHA nĨmekaga ũthuthuria wa wũici wa nyũmba ingĨ cia mũingĨ kũrĨa Oakland.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Bendi nĨyakanjire rwĨmbo kũrĨa War Memorial Stadium ya Maui, rũrĨa rwerĨgĨrĨirwo gukorwo na andũ ta 9000, na makihoya ũkirĨrĨria kuuma kũrĨ arũmĨrĨri ao.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Kambuni ĨrĨa ĨrũgamagĨrĨra bandi ya HK management inc. ndĨaheanire gĨtũmi ona kĨrĨkũ hindĨ irĨa yakanjire kũri mweri 20 wa Kenda no makĨgwatia itũmi cihutanĨtie na mĨbango mũthenya ũyũ ũngĨ.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Wakiri me ngumo kuuma Giriki arĨa nĨo Sakis Kechagioglou na George Nikolakopoulos nĨmohetwo njera-inĨ ya Athens tondũ nĨmanyitĨkire na mahĨtia ma wĨici na ungumania.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Nĩũndũ wa gĩtũmi gĩkĩ, ihĩtia inene thĩ-inĩ wa rũhonge rwa ũcirithania Giriki nĩrĩyumĩrĩtie kuumana na ciĩko mũgarũ wa watho cia aciri, njaji na mawakiri mĩaka ĩigana ũna mĩthiru kũmenyekana.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Ciumia cigana-ũna ciarĨkĨtie gũthira, thutha wa uhoro kwandĨkwo nĨ mũmemerekia Makis Triantafylopoulo thĨiniĨ wa gĨbindi gĨake kĨ ngumo gĨa TV kĨa "Zoungla" thĨiniĨ wa TV ya Alpha, mũbunge na wakili Petros Mantouvalos niatĨgithirio wĨra nĨũndũ wa andũ a wabici yake kunyĨtikana na uungumania ugarũ na watho.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Kuongerera harĨ macio, mũcĨrĨthania Evangeros Kalousis nĨohirwo nĨ kũnyitĨkana na mahĨtia ma ungumania na mĨtugo mĨũrũ.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts nĨaregire uraithi biũ kuuga rĨrĨa etikitie muoyo wambagia, kĨũria kĨrĨa gĨ bata mũno hĨndĨ ĨrĨa tũrarĨrĨria maundũ megainie na uruti wa ihu, akiuga atĨ nĨ kwaga ũigĨrĨrĨki kũarĨrĨria maundũ makuruhanĨte na ndeto ici.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: ohindi o Ĩyo niacokirie murugamo wake wa hau kabere atĨ Roe V.Wade warĨ " settled law of land" agĨtĨtĨrithia fata wa igoti rĨrĨa Ĩnene kuruta mawatho rĨrumĨrĨire
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: O rĨngĨ nĨakinyĨrĨirie atĨ nietĨkanĨtie na kĨhooto kĨa kũgĨa na thiri kĨrĨa gĨatongoririe itua rĨa Roe.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore nĨarĨkirie e wa mbere pointi ithathatũ igũrũ wa Noosa ũrĨa waarĨ wa keerĨ.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: MĨena yeerĨ nĨyacemanirie thĨiniĨ wa nuthu final kũrĨa Noosa arũmĨrĨire ahotani na pointi 11.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore nake akĨhoota Caboolture thĨiniĨ wa final.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae nĨ species ya bamĨrĨ ya Dromaeosaurida na nĨ cousin ya Velociraptor.
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Nyoni Ĩno ya kũhĨta Ĩria Ĩihũire njoya na nĨ ya thakame hiũ yetĨkĨtio atĨ yathiaga Ĩrũgamite na magũrũ meerĨ na ndwara ta Velociraptor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Rwara rwayo rwa keerĨ rwarĨ rũnene na nĨkĨo yetirwo Hesperonychus ĨrĨa yugĨte atĨ "rwara rwa ithũĨrwo."
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Hamwe na mbarabu ĨrĨa yagũaga, gũthũka kwa rĨera nĨkwahotomagia mĨhango ya kũhonokia.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pitman augire atĨ rĨera rĨtingĨagĨra nginya kiumia kĨu kĨngĨ.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: Mũigana na ũtungu wa mbarabu ĨrĨa yaitĨkĨte, kũringana na Pitman, yaarĨ ĨrĨa nyingĨ mũno harĨ mĨaka 15 ĨrĨa yarĨkĨtie gũthira.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Habari nĩitabĩtio cia kunyitwo kwa mũrutwo ũngĩ kuumana na jũragano thukuruinĩ mweri wa March 21, gũkũ mathiko ma Jeff Weise na atatũ a arĩa kenda moragirwo megwĩkĩkaga.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Thigari itiheanĩte riboti makĩria ma kũrũgama na kũnyitanwo kwa ũmũthĩ.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: No riboti kuuma kwĩ mundũ ũĩ thitango ĩno nicikinyĩire Minneapolis Star-Tribune cikiuga atĩ kimwana kĩu ni Louis Jourdain, kĩrĩa kĩna mĩaka 16 na nĩ mwana wa chairman wa Red Lake Tribal, Floyd Jourdain
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Gũtiũĩkaine nginyagia rĩũ thitango iria cigũtabanio kana nĩkĩĩ gĩtũmĩ kia kũnyitwo gwa kimwana kĩu no thitango cia andũ anini nĩciajĩtie igot-inĩ rĩa federal.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Lodin nĨongereire kuuga atĨ atongoria moire ikinya rĨa kũrũgamia ithurano cia gũcokera nĨguo marigĨrĨrie mahũthĨrwo na uhotekeku wa ũgitĨri gũthũka kuumana na gĨthurano kĨngĨ.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Diplomats maugire atĨ nĨmonire gatiba ya Afghan Ĩna tutithio tũingĨ turĨa twatũmire mauge Ĩthurano cia gũcokera ti cia bata
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Maũndũ maya nĩ mararegana na riboti cia hau kabere iria ciaugaga atĩ gũkanja ithurano cia gũcokera nĩ mũgare wa gatiba.
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: Ndege Ĩyo yathiaga Irkutsk na yatwarithagio ni birarũ ciĨ thĨiniĨ.
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: KamĨtĨ nĨyathondekirwo gũthuthuria.
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: KIl- 76 Ĩkoretwo Ĩ gicunjĨ kĨnene kĨa birarũ cia Russia na cia Soviet kũũma mĨaka-inĨ ya 1970s, no nĨ irarĨ na mũtino mũnene Russia mweri-inĨ ũcio ũrathirire.
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: KũrĨ Oktomba 7, injini nĨyagũire ndege Ĩkienda kũmbũka. Russia nĨyambire kũrũgamia Il- 76s thuutha wa mũtino ũcio.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: Mũigana wa mairũ 800 cia mĨberethi ya Trans-Alaska Pipeline nĨyahingirwo kũrũmĨrĨra gũitĨka kwa makiri ma barrels cia maguta mũhuro wa Fairbanks, Alaska.
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Gũthũka gwa thitima thuutha wa mageria ma mĨtambo ya mwaki nĨkuo gwacũngĨrĨirie relief valves kũhingũka na maguta magĨitika hakuhĨ na gĨtuo kĨa maguta gĨa Fort Greely mbombo namba 9.
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: Kũhingũka gwa valves gwatũmire mũtambo ũrekererie mĨruke na maguta makĨambĨrĨria guitĨkĨra itangi rĨrĨa rĨarĨ na ũhoti wa gũkua barrels 55,000(gallons milioni 2.3).
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: GũkinyĨria wagatatũ mĨarahũko, vents cia itangi no ciaitaga maguta kwahoteka nĨũndũ wa ũrugarĨ thĨiniĨ wa itangi.
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Handũ hangĨ ha kũiga maguta mũigana wa barrels 104,500 rungu rwa matangi hatiaihũrĨtio.
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Mĩario ĩrĩa yonanagio ĩmwe kwa ĩmwe television inĩ, yarĩ riita rĩa mbere mũnene wa Iranian Sources gwĩtĩkĩra atĩ mĩkana ĩrĩa mekĩrĩiro nĩ ya mahutagia.
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Na nĩ ta mĩkana ya kĩ mbeca na kũgirio nĩ kĩama kĩa ũnyitanĩri wa Europe EU kwendia ũiro mabũrũri-inĩ macio, ũrĩa ũheaga uchumi wa bũrũri ũcio kĩgĩna kuuma wendia-inĩ kĩa mĩrongo ĩnana harĩ igana kuuma ja wa bũrũri.
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: Harĩ riport ĩrĩa ĩrĩgĩte kũrekererio ica ikuhĩ, OPEC ĩkiuga indo iria ciendagio mabũrũri ma nja nĩ inyihĩte igathiĩ thĩ mũno ingĩringithanio na mĩaka mĩrongo ĩrĩ mĩhetũku nginya mĩkebe ĩrĩ gaturuma inyanya o harĩ mũthenya.
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Mũtongoria ũrĩa mũnene mũno bũrũri-inĩ ũcio, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, nĩatarĩirie atĩ kwĩhoka maguta nĩ ta "mũtego" kuma mbere ya Islamic revolution ya Iran mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo mũgwanja na kenda na kuma rĩrĩa bũrũri ũcio wagĩrĩirwo nĩ kwĩyohorithia.
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Narĩrĩa capsure ĩkaingĩra atmosphere thĩ, kĩndũ thaa ikũmi na ĩmwe cia kĩroko mathaa ma eastern, nĩ ĩrĩgĩrĩirwo gũkonania monanio ma ũtheri kũrĩ aikari a Northern California, Oregon, Nevada na Utah.
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Capsule ĩyo nĩ ĩkonekana mũno ta njata ĩrakĩrania igũrũ.
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Capsule ĩyo nĩ ĩgakorwo ĩgĩthiĩ na kilometer ikũmi na igĩrĩ gaturuma inyanya kana miles inyanya harĩ second, ihenya rĩngĩhotithia kuma San Franscisco ngiya Los Angeles na ndagĩka o ĩmwe.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust nĩ ĩkaiga rekodi njerũ ya ihinda rĩothe nĩ gũkorwo ĩrĩ spacecraft ya mbere gũcoka thĩ na ihenya mũno, ĩkĩbuja record ĩrĩa yaigirwo mweri wa gatano mwaka wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo ĩtandatũ na kenda rĩrĩa Apollo X command module yacokaga.
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: Nĩ ĩgathiĩra igũrũ wa West Coast ya northern California na nĩ ĩgekiĩa utheri kuma California kũhĩtũkĩra Central Oregon na kũhĩtũkĩra Nevada na Idaho na nginya Utah. Tom Duxbury, mũrũgamĩrĩri wa project akiuga.
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Itua rĩa Mr. Rudd rĩa kũhũra kĩrore uiguithanĩrĩo wa rĩera rĩratiganĩria America, ũrĩa ũgũkoro ũrĩ bũrũri oguo ũrĩa utetĩkĩranĩtie na ũiguithanio ũcio harĩ mabũrũri marĩa mothe mathiĩte na mbere.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: Nayo thirikari hetũkũ ya conservative bũrũri wa Australia nĩ waregete kũhũra kĩrore Kyoto, ĩkiuga nĩ ũgũthũkia uchumi nĩũndũ wa wĩhoki mũnene wa wendia nja wa bũrũri wa coal, rĩrĩa mabũrũri mangĩ ta India na China mateyohanĩtie na matua macio ma ũthũkia wa rĩera.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: ũcĩo nĩguo warĩ ũgũrĩ ũrĩa mũnene rũgano-inĩ rwa eBay.
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: Kĩgaanda kĩu nĩkĩratanya kũararamia honge cia ũrehi wa baida na kũongerera ũmenyekani kũndũ guothe Skype ĩkorago na hinya, ta China, Europe ya irathĩro na Brazil.
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Athomi a cayanci nĩmarekuĩra Enceladus no ĩrathii na mbere kurekereria indo na nĩkĩo kĩhumo kĩa bete njoherera ĩrĩa ithiururukĩirie Saturn.
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Enceladus nĩkĩo kĩndũ kĩrĩa kĩonagerĩria mũno harĩ indo iria itũthiũrũrũkaga riũa, yonanagia hakuhĩ mĩrongo kenda harĩ igana ya ũtheri wa riũa ũrĩa ũrikinyagĩrũa.
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: Mũcabithia wa mĩthako wa Konami ũraugire gatheti-ini ya ũmũthĩ ya Japan atĩ matirerekagĩrĩria mũthako wa thikũ ithathatũ Fallujah.
text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Mũthako ũyũ ũigĩmaine na haro ya keerĩ ya Fallujah, haro ĩno ĩrerekana ĩrarĩ njũrũ gatagatĩnĩ ka America na mbũtũ cia Iraqi
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: Ningĩ ACMA yonire o na gũtũĩka video nĩ ĩrekererio intaneti-ini, Big Brother ndĩnathiĩ mũgarũ wa ihoto cia ũiguano wa kĩĩwatho nĩũndũ mbica ndĩraigĩtwo ng'eda cia ũhoro cia Big Brother.
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: Watho wa ũtũngata wa ũmemerekia ũheanĩtĩ mawatho ma kũramata ciugo cia intaneti-inĩ, no o na kũrĩ ũguo nĩ getha ũhoro ũcio wa intanet-inĩ wĩtĩkĩrĩke no ginya ĩkorwo ĩrĩ server-ini.
text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: Nayo obici ĩrĩa ĩrũgamagĩrĩra bũrũri wa America ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo Nairobi, Kenya ĩkĩheana mũkana atĩ "itoi kuma Somalia" nĩ irabanga kũambĩrĩria tharĩkĩra cia bomu cia kwĩrutĩra gũkua mabũrũri-inĩ ma Kenya na Ethiopia.
text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: Naguo bũrũri wa America ũkiuga nĩ ũnyitĩte ũhoro kuma mĩena mĩhithĩrĩre ĩrĩa ĩgwetete ũtũmĩri wa erutĩri gũkua kũhũra bomu nĩ ũkwambĩrĩria " igweta rĩa bata" kũu Ethiopia na Kenya.
text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Mbere kũraihu, Daily Show na Colbert Report, Heck na Johnson nĩmagĩte na kĩoneki gĩa kũrutithia mũingĩ-inĩ tabarira cia kũnyũrũria mohoro, na ũrekereria wa mohoro, rĩrĩa marĩ arutwo UW mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo ĩnana na inyanya.
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Kuma yambĩrĩrio, The Onion nĩ ĩtuĩkĩte athamaki ama a mohoro ma kinyũrũri ma gukenia andũ, na ĩngĩ ya gũcabithio, na rũrenda  rũngĩ rũgucĩrĩirie aceri million ithano mweri wa ikũmi, na imenyithia cia biacara, na mohoro mũthenya wothe, na nĩ merĩgĩte kũrutithia  ibuku rĩa monereria rĩtago Our Dumb World.
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Al Gore na mũnene wa birarũ Tommy Franks na itherũ makĩarĩrĩria ũhoro ũrĩa wa makenagia mũno (Ya Gore yarĩ rĩrĩa The Onion yanĩrĩire atĩ we na Tipper nĩrĩo makoragwo na rĩonana rĩa kĩmwĩrĩ rĩa ũtũũro wao thutha wa kũhoto ithurano cia Electoral College mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ).
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Ciira ũcio watuithanĩirio Virginia nĩ ũndũ nĩkuo mũciĩ wa atongoria harĩ ũheani wa ũtungati wa initaneti AOL, kambũni ĩrĩa yatwarĩte ciira ũcio.
text_en: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

text: Rĩrĩ nĩrĩo rita rĩa mbere ciira ũtuithanĩtio magĩtũmĩra watho ũrĩa wahetũkirio mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na ithatũ kũnina ũtũmi wa e-mail nyingĩ iria ciĩtagwo spam, kuma kũrĩ atũmi matoĩkaine ni arĩa maranyita e-mail icio mathandũkũ mao thĩinĩ.
text_en: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

text: Jesus, wa mĩaka mĩrongo irĩ na ĩmwe aingĩrire kĩrabu kĩa Manchester City mwaka mĩthiru mweri wa mbere mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na ikĩmi na mĩgwanja kuma kĩrabu kĩa Brazil Palmeiras harĩ kĩgĩna kĩriboteto gĩa Paundi million mĩrongo-irĩ na mĩgwanja.
text_en: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

text: Kuma hĩndĩ-ĩyo raiya ũcio wa Brazil nĩakuruhanĩtio na mĩthako mĩrongo ĩtano na ithatũ ya kĩrabu mathako-inĩ mothe, na akaingĩria mbaũ mĩrongo-irĩ na inya.
text_en: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text: Dagĩtarĩ Lee akiuga nĩ athumbũragwo nĩ riboti atĩ ciana bũrũri-inĩ wa Turkey nĩ magwatĩtio mũrimu wa A(H5N1) avian influenza virus gũtarĩ kũrũara.
text_en: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text: ũthuthuria ũngĩ nĩ wonanĩtie atĩ mũrimu ũcio no nginyagia ũkorwo ũtarĩ mũru mbere ya ũtuĩkĩte mũtumũko mũru thĩ yoothe, akiuga.
text_en: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text: kwĩna mĩtangĩko atĩ arũaru no mathiĩ na mbere kũgwatia andũ angĩ mũrimũ kũhĩtũkĩra mĩtugo yao ya o mũthenya angĩkorwo ndariri cia homa ĩyo igũikara irĩ njũru.
text_en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Leslie Aun, mwaria wa Komen Foundation, akiuga kĩama nĩ kĩyũkĩtie watho mwerũ ũtetĩkĩrĩtie kũhe kana kũruta mbeca cia kũhe kĩũngano kĩrĩa kĩrathuthurio kĩ watho.
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: Mũtaratara ũcio wa Komen waninire ũciari mũbange nĩũndũ wa ũthuthuria wathiaga na mbere wa ũrĩa ũciari mũbange ũtũmĩraga na ũkaheana riboti cia mbeca, ũthuthuria ũrĩa ũreko nĩ Representative Cliff Stearns.
text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Stearns nĩ ĩrathuthuria kana magoti nĩ marahũthĩka kũhe mbeca ũruti wa ihu kũhĩtũkĩra ũciari mũbange wĩra-inĩ wake eta mũnene wa Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, rũrĩa rwĩ thĩ ya iburi rĩa kamĩtĩ ya House Energy and Commerce.
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: ũrĩa warĩ ngavana wa Massachusetts Mit Romney acindire gĩthurano-inĩ kĩa Republican Party presidential elections mũthenya wa waĩrĩ na gacunjĩ ka mĩrongo ĩna na ithathatũ  ga kura ciothe.
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: ũrĩa warĩ mwaria wa bunge Newt Gingrich agĩtuĩka wa kerĩ na gacuji ka mĩrongo ĩtatũ na igĩrĩ.
text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Gĩ ta gĩcigĩrĩra kĩrĩa mũhotani oyaga gĩothe, Florida ĩkĩheana delegates othe mĩrongo ĩtano gwĩ Romney, ũndũ ũrĩa wamũtwarire mbere harĩ gũcagũro eta mũrũgamĩrĩri wa kĩama kĩa Republican.
text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Arĩa mabangĩte mũrũrũngano ũcio makiuga kwarĩ na andũ ngiri igana rĩmwe arĩa meyumĩrĩtie mataũni-inĩ ma Germany ta Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, na Hanover.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: Itũrainĩ rĩa Berlin borithi nĩmarakũĩra arũrũngani 6,500.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Mĩrũrũngano ĩngĩ nĩĩhanĩkĩte maturainĩ ma Paris, Sofia thĩini wa Bulgaria, Vilnius thĩ-inĩ wa Lithuania, Valetta thĩ-inĩ wa Malta, Tallinn thĩ-inĩ wa Estonia, na Edinburgh na Glasgow thĩini wa Scotland.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: Andũ makuhĩrĩirie 200 kũrĩa London, nimarũrũnganĩte nja wa wabici imwe cia ene copyright anene.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Nikwarĩ mĩrũrũngano mũnene mweri mũhetũku kũria Poland rĩrĩa bũrũri ũcio wahũrire kĩrore ACTA, ĩrĩa ĩtũmĩte thirikari ya Poland ĩtue dĩkũhetũkia wĩiguithanio ũcio.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Latvia na Slovakia nĩ mabĩte kũrũgamia mũtaratara wa kuĩngĩra ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: ciama cia kũhonokia na kũgitĩra nyamũ kuma kũherithio nĩcio cia Animal Liberation na the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) nĩ iroria kũgĩe na watho wa gũtigĩrĩra no mũhaka kamera cia CCTV gwĩkĩro kũrĩa guothe kũrĩ na gĩthĩnjĩro Australia.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Inspector mũnene mwerũ wa RSPCA New South Wales nĩwe David O'Shannessy akĩra ABC atĩ kũrora na gũthuthuria ĩthĩnjĩro wagĩrĩirwo nĩ gũkorwo ũrĩ ũndũ ũrekĩka kaingĩ bũrũri-inĩ wa Australia.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: "CCTV hatarĩ nganja no ĩtũme kĩmenyithia kĩnene kũrĩ arĩa marutaga wĩra na nyamũ atĩ ũrũmbũyania wacio nĩ ũigĩtwo mbere mũno."
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Mabu ya United States Geological Survey yonanirie gũtirĩ ithingithia thĩ-inĩ wa Iceland wiki ĩ mwe mbere.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Wabici ya Icelandic Meteorological onayo dĩarutĩte riboti cia gũtuthũka gwa kĩrĩma thĩ-inĩ wa Hekla harĩ mathaa mĩrongo ĩna na manana mahĩtũku.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Gĩthingithia kĩu gĩatũmire kũgie ũgarũrũku wa maũndũ kĩahanĩkĩte mweri ikũmi mweri-inĩ wa gatatũ mwena wa itherero wa volcano ya kĩrĩma kĩu.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Matu mairũ marĩa mataakonainiĩ na gututhũka gwa volcano ĩ yo nĩmonekete magũrũinĩ ma kĩrĩma kĩu.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Matu nimangĩahĩngĩcire andũ gũkionekana ta mututhũko wekĩkĩte.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Luno yaarĩ na maguta ma mita cia kũihũrio igana rĩmwe rĩa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ nginya igana rĩmwe rĩa mĩrongo ĩtandatũ rĩrĩa yaathũũkire ĩgĩkuuo nĩ huuho na makũmbĩ ma iria nginya harĩa rũthingo rwa kũrũgamia makũmbĩ rwakĩtwo.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Ndege cia helicopters ikĩhonokia aruti a wĩra ikũmi na erĩ na nguraro ĩrĩa yonekire yarĩ o ya kunĩka iniũrũ.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Meri ĩyo yarĩ ya mita igana rĩmwe yathiaga gũkua mũrigo wa bataraitha ta kamenyeri, na kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ atongoria nĩ metigagĩra atĩ meri ĩyo no ĩite mũrigo.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: ũcenjia wa watho ũrĩa wandĩkithĩtio nĩ wahatũkĩte nyũmba cierĩ cia gũthondeka mawatho.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Mogarũrũku nĩ mekirwo gĩikaro-inĩ kĩu gĩa gũthondeka mawatho rĩrĩa mũhari wa kerĩ watharirio rĩa mbere nĩ House of Representatives na ũkĩhetũkio ũhana ũguo nĩ Senate mũthenya wa mwambĩrĩrio.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Kũgũa kwa mũhari wa kerĩ, kũrĩa kũrendithia kũninwo kwa ihiko cia andũ mena ũciari ũhanaine, no ũhingũre mĩrango ya ngwatanĩro cia andũ ta acio mĩaka ĩgũka.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Kũrũmĩrĩra mũtaratara ũcio, HJR-3 nĩ ikarorwo rĩngĩ nĩ athondeki a mawatho arĩa megũthuurwo  mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na ikũmi na ithano kana ngiri igĩrĩ na ikũmi na ithathatũ nĩguo maikare mũtaratara-inĩ.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Maũndũ marĩa Vautier ahotete kũhingia nja ya ũtongoria nĩ nginyagia kũrega kũrĩa gwa kahinda karaihu mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo mũgwanja na ithatũ akĩregana na ũndũ ũrĩa etaga kũhingĩrĩrio kĩ ũteti.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Watho wa France nĩ wa cenjirio. ũhũrani wake kũrehe mogarũrũku wambĩrĩirie arĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka ikũmi na ĩtano rĩrĩa aingĩrire gĩkundi kĩa French Resistance hĩndĩ ya haro ya thĩ ya keerĩ.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Akĩandĩka ibuku-inĩ mwaka wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo kenda na inyanya.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Mĩaka-inĩ ya ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo ĩtandatũ, agĩcoka bũrũri ũrĩa wakoretwo waheo wĩyathi wa Algeria gũthomithia ũthondeki wa thinema.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Judoka Hitoshi Saito kuma Japan ũrĩa wacindire thahabu igĩrĩ macindano-inĩ ma Olympics nĩ arakuire arĩ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtano na ĩna.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Kĩhumo gĩa gĩkuũ gĩake kĩranĩrĩirwo gĩ ta mũrimũ wa cancer ya mĩberethi ĩrĩa ĩkuaga nyongo mani-inĩ.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Akuĩrĩire Osaka mũthenya wa kerĩ.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: O ta ũrĩa warĩ mũhotani wa olympic na thĩ yothe, Saito arĩ mũtongoria wa kamĩtĩ ya gũthomithania ya All Japan Judo Federation nginyagia hĩndĩ ya gĩkuo gĩake.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Andũ matanyihĩirie igana rĩmwe nĩ makinyĩte iruga-inĩ rĩu, nĩ guo gũkenerera gũthira kwa mwaka umwe kuma rĩrĩa ahikania acio mekire ũhiki.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: ũndũ ũngĩ ũbacĩrĩirwo kĩ wabici nĩ wabangirwo nginya mũthenya ũngĩ ũgũka, anene kuuga.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Ahikania acio mahikanĩirie Texas mwaka ũmwe mũhetũku na magĩũka Buffalo gũkenerera na arata na andũ a nyũmba.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Mũthuri ũcio wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ, ũrĩa wa ciarĩirwo Buffalo, arĩ ũmwe wa arĩa moragĩirwo ũrathi-inĩ ũcio wa mĩcinga, no mũtumia wake ndaguraririo.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno nĩ oĩkaine mũno no mũrutani ũcio warehaga ngarari ũrĩa wathomithagia rungu rũa gĩthomo gĩa kĩ rĩu na King's Glory atuĩkaga athomithagia aruto ngiri kenda hĩndĩ ĩrĩa wĩra wake warĩ igũrũ.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Mandĩko-inĩ make nĩ atũmĩraga ciugo iria aciari monaga ĩrĩ cia irumi, na nĩerĩkanaga nĩ agaga kĩene kĩrathi-inĩ.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Gĩthomo kĩa matukũ maya nĩkĩamũkagĩrĩra nĩ gũcabithia imenyithia cia kũgathĩrĩria nene mbathi-inĩ atarĩ na rũtha na kũhenania na kuuga atĩ nĩwe warĩ mũrutani mũnene wa gĩthũngũ.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Oho nĩ athitangirwo na mehia ma kũbunja watho wa copyrights, no ndathitangirwo.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Mũrutwo wa gatene akiuga atĩ "Nĩ atũmagĩra ciugo cia ũra thoni kĩrathi-inĩ, agathomithania ũgĩ wa maceera ma gũtuma ndũgũ makĩandĩkaga, na aikaraga ta mũrata wa arutwo.
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Harĩ mĩaka ta mĩrongo ĩtatũ mĩhetũku, ona angĩkorwo kĩ obici ũikarĩte ũrĩ bũrũri ũtongoragio nĩ mũtaratara wa kũgaya ũtonga wa bũrũri kũrĩ andũ othe, China nĩ ũkũrĩtie thoko ya ũtonga wa bũrũri ũrĩa thogora na ũthondeki wa indo ũringanaga na ũcindani ũtarĩ mũingĩrĩre nĩ thirikari gatagatĩ ka biacara cia andũ kĩũmbe.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Mogarũrũku ma mbere ma ũtonga wa bũrũri mathondekirwo rungu rwa ũtongoria wa Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Kuma hĩndĩ-ĩyo ũtonga wa ucumi wa bũrũri ũcio ũkũrĩte maita mĩrongo kenda.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Rita rĩa mbere, mwaka mũthiru, China ĩkĩendia nja ya bũrũri ngaari nyingĩ gũkĩra Germany na ũkĩhetũka United States ta thoko iria nene ya kĩganda gĩkĩ.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: ũtonga wa kĩ mbeca wa indo iria ciothe ithondekagĩrwo na ĩgatũmĩrwo china, GDP, no ũkorro wĩ mũnene gũkĩra wa United States harĩ mĩaka mĩrongo irĩ mĩũku.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Kĩhuhũkanio gĩa tropical Danielle, kĩrĩa nĩkĩo gĩa kana kũheo rĩtwa harĩ kĩmera kĩa ihuhũkania cia Atlantic mwaka wa ngiri igĩri na ikũmi, nĩ gĩethondekete irathĩro rĩa iria rĩa Atlantic.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Kĩhuhũkanio, kĩrĩa kĩrĩ kĩndũ mairo ngiri ithatũ kuuma Miami, Florida, kĩrakinyia huuho cia mairo mĩrongo ĩna harĩ ithaa (kiromita mĩrongo ĩtandatũ na inya harĩ ithaa)
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Scientists a National Hurricane Center nĩmararathĩre atĩ Danielle nĩ gĩkũongerereka hinya gĩtuike kĩhuhũkanio kĩnene gũgĩkinya mũthenya wa gatatũ.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Na tondu kĩhuhũkanio kĩu nĩ kĩraihĩrĩirie thĩ nyũmũ, nĩ ũtuĩkĩte ũndũ mũritu gũthima maumĩrĩra kũrĩ bũrũri wa America kana Carribean.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: ũrĩa a ciarĩirwo gĩikaro kĩnene gĩa Croatia, Zagreb, Bobek agĩire ngumo rĩrĩa athakagĩra Partizan Belgrade.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Anyitanĩire nao mwaka wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo ĩna na ithano na agĩikara nginya ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo ĩtano na ĩnana.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Kahinda-inĩ gake na timu ĩyo, nĩ aingĩririe mbao magana mana ma ithatũ harĩ mĩthako ĩrĩa akuruhanirio nayo magana mana ma mĩrongo ĩtandatũ na inyanya.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩ ũrĩ wathaka mĩthako mĩingĩ mũno kana akaingĩria mbao nyingĩ cia kĩrabu gũkĩra Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo kenda na ithano, agĩthurwo arĩ mũthaki mwega mũno Historĩ inĩ ya Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Nakuo gũkũngũĩra kũu kwambĩrĩirie na monanio ma mwanya nĩ gĩkundi kĩũĩkaine thĩ yothe kĩa Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: ĩarũmĩrĩirwo nĩ gĩkundi kĩa aini kĩa Instanbul State Symphony Orchestra, mbandi ya Janissary, na aini ta Fatih Eroc na Muslum Gurses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Thutha ũcio nao Whirling Dervishes makĩoya stage.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Mũirĩtu mũini wa Turkey Sezen Aksu akĩina na mũini wa Italy Alessandro Safina na mũini kuma Greece nĩwe Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Kũrĩkĩrĩria, gĩkundi kĩa aini ndaci ya Turkey nĩkĩo Fire of Anatolia gĩkĩina "Troy"
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, mũtwarithia wa kibikibi cia mahenya, nĩ arakuire thutha wa gũkuruhanio mũtino-inĩ Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Arĩ ithiũrũrũka rĩa kwĩharĩria, Lenz akĩgwa kuma kibikibi inĩ yake, na akĩringwo nĩ mũtwarithia ũmwe wa arĩa macindanaga nake nĩwe Xaxier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Nĩ atangĩkĩirwo na ihenya nĩ arigitani a kĩharo-inĩ na agĩtwaro thibitarĩ ĩrĩa yarĩ hakuhĩ kũrĩa akuĩrĩire thutha ũcio.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat ndakuĩrĩire mũtino-inĩ ũcio.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Kũringana na ũrĩa thĩ ĩikarite kĩ mbeca, Zapatero agĩthiĩ na mbere kuuga atĩ "mũtabarĩre wa kĩ mbeca nĩ rũhonge rũmwe rũa ũtonga wa bũrũri, rũa bata mũno."
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Tũrĩ na mwaka ũmwe mũraihu wa moritũ na mathĩna ma kĩ mbeca, ũrĩa ũkoretwo ũrehete mathĩna moru harĩ mĩeri ĩrĩ mĩhetũku, na niĩ ndĩreciria atĩ thoko cia wendia wa mbeca nĩ ĩrambĩrĩria gũcokereria gwĩka wega.
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Kiumia kĩhetũku, Naked News makĩanĩrĩra atĩ nĩ mekũongerera na njĩra mwanya watho wa rũthiomi rwa mabũrũri ma na nja harĩ ũmemerekia wa mohoro, rĩu nĩũndũ wa nyũmba ithatũ njerũ cia mohoro.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: ĩrĩa nĩ yakorago ĩkĩmemerekia na thiomi cia gĩthũngũ, Japanese, kĩũngano kĩu gĩkoragwo thĩ yothe nĩ kĩrambĩrĩria tabarĩra cia ũmemerekia na thiomi ta Spanish, Italian na Korea gutumĩra TV, rũrenda na thimu cia moko.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Kĩ mũnyaka, gũtirĩ ũndũ wa hanĩkire he niũ, no nĩ ndonire ũndũ wahanaga gĩkuũ, rĩrĩa andũ mageragia kũbunja dirica nĩgetha maume.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Andũ nĩ maringaga ndirica na itĩ, no ndirica itiabunjĩkaga.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Muthia ndirica ĩmwe ĩkĩbunjĩka, na makĩambĩrĩria kumĩra ndirica," ũrĩa watigarire Franciszek Kowal akiuga.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Njata ĩrutaga ũtheri na ũrugarĩ nĩ ũndũ wa hĩnya ũrĩa ĩrutaga rĩrĩa atoms cia hydrogen itukanaga (kana ikanyitithanio hamwe) hamwe gũthondeka indo nditũ.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Scientists nĩ mararuta wĩra gũthondeka macini ya gũtukania ĩrĩa ĩngĩthondeka hinya na njĩra o ta ĩyo.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: ũndũ ũyũ, ona kũrĩ o ũguo, nĩ mũritũ mũno kũona kĩhonia na nĩ ũrabatara mĩaka mĩingĩ mbere ya tũonete macini cia bata cia gũtukania igĩthondekwo.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Cindano ĩyo ya cuma ĩreraga maĩ-inĩ igũrũ nĩũndũ wa surface tension.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Surface tension ĩhotekaga nĩ ũndũ molecules cia maĩ-inĩ igũrũ nĩ igucanagia na hinya mũno gũkĩra urĩa igucagĩrĩrio nĩ molecules cia rĩera-inĩ.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Molecules cia maĩ ithondekaga ngothi ĩtonekaga surface inĩ ya maĩ ĩrĩa ĩtĩkagĩria indo ta cindano kũrera igũrũ rĩa maĩ.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Rweji rũrĩa rũkoragwo skate inĩ cia mbarabu cia kĩrĩu rũkoragwo na mĩena ĩrĩ ya kũrenga na mwanya wĩgonyete gatatĩ-inĩ ga cio. Mĩena ĩyo yerĩ ĩtĩkagĩria kũnyita mbarabu ĩyo wega, nginyagia rĩrĩa ĩinamĩte.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Na tondũ mwena wa na thĩ nĩ wĩgonyete hanini, rĩrĩa rwenji rũrainama mwena ũmwe, mũthia ũrĩa ũhutanĩtie onaguo nĩ wĩkũnjaga.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: ũndũ ũyũ ũtũmaga mũndũ ũrĩa ũra skate kũgarũrũka. Angĩkorwo skates nĩ ĩregata mwena wa ũrĩo, skater agarũrũkaga na mwena wa ũrĩo, angĩkorwo skates ĩragarũrũka na mwena wa ũmotho, skater nake akagarũrũka na mwena wa ũmotho.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Gũcokia gĩthimi kĩa hinya ũrĩa ciakinyĩtie hau kabere, no nginyagia irute hinya wa kwĩyongerera ũrĩa ukoragwo umĩte kwĩ ũtheri.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ciĩkaga ũgũo na njĩra ya kũrekereria particle nini cia ũtheri ciĩtagwo "photon".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Scientists metaga mũtaratara ũyũ "stimulated emission of radiation" nĩ ũndũ atoms nĩ irurumũragwo nĩ ũtheri mũnene, igatũma kũrekereria kwa photon ya ũtheri, na ũtheri nĩ mũthemba wa radiation.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Mbica iria irũmĩrĩire ironania atom ĩkĩrekereria photons. Hatarĩ ngaja, ũrĩa kũrĩ nĩ atĩ, photons nĩ nini mũno gũkĩra icio ciĩ mbica-inĩ.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Photons nĩ ikoragwo nginya ciĩ nini gũkĩra indo iria ithondekaga atoms.
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Thutha wa magana ma mathaa ma ũruti wa wĩra, filament iria ikoragwo ngirobu-inĩ ihĩaga na ngirobu icio cia ũtheri itirutaga wĩra rĩngĩ.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Ngirobu ĩyo ya ũtheri kwa ũguo nĩ ĩbataraga gũcenjanio. Nĩ ũndũ wa bata mũno kwĩmenyerera ũgĩcenjia ngirobu cia ũtheri.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Wa mbere, switch ya indo cia ũtheri nĩ irabatara kũhorio kana waya ĩrekithanio.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Gĩtũmi kĩa ũguo nĩ atĩ thitima ĩrĩa ĩrathiĩra socket inĩ harĩa mwena wa cuma ngirobu-inĩ ĩyo iraikarĩra no hakũhe cũkũ ya thitima njũru ũngĩnyita socket thĩinĩ kana Cuma iria ikorago ngirobu-inĩ, ingĩkorwo ihutĩtie hanini socket inĩ.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Kĩĩga kĩrĩa kĩa bata harĩ mũtabarĩre wa gũthiũrũrũkia thakame nĩ ngoro, ĩrĩa ĩhũraga thakame.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Thakame yumaga ngoro kũhĩtũkĩra mĩferethi ĩtagwo mĩkiha ya arteries na ĩgacoka ngoro mĩferethi-inĩ kana mĩkiha ĩtagwo veins.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Magego ma triceratop nĩ mangĩahotire gũthĩa tiga o mahuti no nginyagia thari nyũmũ na mĩri.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Scientists amwe nĩ meciragia atĩ Triceratops nĩ ciarĩaga cycads, ĩrĩa nĩ mĩthemba ya mĩmera ĩrĩa yonekanaga mũno Cretaceous.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Mĩmera ĩyo ĩhana ta mũtĩ mũnini wa mĩkĩndũ wĩna thũmbĩ ya mahuti mogĩ na mena mĩigua.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratops no ĩkorwo yatũmĩraga mũkanye wayo warĩ na hinya kũrutania mahuti mbere ya kũrĩa gĩtina kĩa mũtĩ.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Asayansi acio angĩ maugaga atĩ mĩmera ĩyo nĩ ĩkoragwo na ũrogi mũingĩ kwa ũguo hatirĩ na ũhoteteku atĩ dinosa nĩ cia mĩrĩaga, ona akorwo sloth na parrot (iria ciĩtanĩtio na dinosaur) no irĩe mahuti kana matunda mena ũrogi.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Gravity ya Lo ĩngĩndindĩka atĩa? ũngĩrũgama surface inĩ ya lo, ũngĩkorwo na ũritũ mũnini gũkĩra ũritũ waku gũkũ thĩ.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Mũndũ ũkoragwo na ũritũ wa paũndi magana merĩ (kiro mĩrongo kenda) gũkũ thĩ angĩkorwo na ũritũ wa paũndi mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ithathatũ (kiro ikũmi na ithathatũ) kũu lo. Kwa ũguo gravity, hatarĩ nganja, ĩgũtindĩkaga hanini.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Riũa rĩtikoragwo na gatagatĩ kena mahiga ta thĩ ũngĩrũgama. Riũa rĩothe rĩthondeketwo nĩ riera, mwaki, na plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Rĩera rĩu rĩcekehaga o ũrĩa ũrathiĩ haraihu na gatagatĩ ka riũa.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Mwena wa mũico ũrĩa twonaga twarora riũa wĩtagwo photosphere, ũgũo nĩ ta kuuga atĩ mũbira wa ũtheri.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Kĩndũ mĩaka ta ĩtatũ thutha ũcio, mwaka wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana matandatũ ma ikũmi, mũtaramu wa maũndũ ma njata na igũrũ wa Italy Galileo Galilei agĩtũmĩra telescope kũrora na kũona atĩ Venus nĩ ĩkoragwo na mĩena ĩna, o ta ũrĩa mweri ũkoragwo.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Mĩena ĩyo ĩkoragwo ho nĩ ũndũ wa atĩ mwena wa Venus (kana wa mweri) ũrĩa ũkoragwo ũrorete riũa nĩ ũkoragwo na ũtheri. Mĩena ĩyo yonekaga ĩna ya Venus nĩ yanyitire mbaru woni wa Copernicus atĩ planets nĩ ithiũrũrũkaga riũa.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Oho, thutha wa mĩaka mĩnini mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana matandatũ ma mĩrongo ĩtatũ na kenda, mũtaramu wa njata na maũndũ ma igũrũ mũthũngũ wetago Jeremiah Horrocks akĩona Venus ĩgĩthiĩ.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Ngeretha nĩ yarĩ na ĩhinda inene rĩa thayũ thutha wa gwitahĩra rĩngĩ itũra rĩa Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Ona kũrĩ ũguo, mwakainĩ wa 991 Ethelred nĩacemanirie na mbatũ ya Viking irĩa yarĩ nene gũkĩra ĩngĩ o yothe kũma iria ya Guthrum miaka igana yarĩkĩtie guthira.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Mbũtũ ĩno yatongoretio nĩ Olaf Trygvasson, wa kuma Norway na ũrĩa warĩ na kĩoneki gĩa kũhonokia bũrũri wake kuuma utongoria wa andũ kuma Denmark.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Thutha wa kwaga gũcinda mbaara, Ethelred nĩaiguithaniirie na Olaf ũria wacokire gũcoka Norway kũgeria kwioera ũthamaki na akigacira kwa njĩra itiganite.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul no yo ndemwa yagũndũririo na mworoto na yũĩkaine ũhũthĩri-inĩ wa o mũthenya. Ndemwa ino yagũndũriruo mwaka wa ngiri ĩmwe magana mana ma mĩrongo ĩna na ĩna kahida-inĩ ka wathani wa mũthamaki Sejong. (1418-1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Mũthamaki Sejong arĩ mũthamaki wa kana wa famĩlĩ ya Joseon na nĩ ũmwe wa arĩa mahetwo gĩtĩo mũno
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Mbere ĩyo nĩetĩte ndemwa ya Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum,ĩrĩa ĩrũgamĩrĩire "mĩgambo ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire nĩũdũ wa waathani wa andũ".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Nĩ kũrĩ na morutani maingĩ ma ũrĩa Sankrit yookire kũmenyeka.  ĩmwe yacio nĩ kũigiĩ ũthamĩri wa Aryan kuuma ithũĩro matonyete India arĩa marehire rũthiomi rwao.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskirt nĩ rũthiomi rwa tene na  rũringithanagio na rũthiomi rwa Latin ũrĩa waragio rũraya.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Ibũku rĩrĩa rĩũĩkaine rĩa tene thiinĩ wa thĩ rĩadĩkirwo na Sanskirt. Thutha wa gũcokanĩrĩria kwa Upanishads, Sanskirt no kũhwererekera ya hũrwererekeire nĩũndũ wa ũtongoria.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskirt nĩ rũthiomi ũrĩ na ũritũ mũno na ũmenyi. ũrĩa ũtũngatĩte ta kĩhũmo kĩa thiomi nyingĩ cia mahinda tũrĩ India, o ta ũrĩa Latin nĩyo kĩhũmo kĩa thiomi cia ngeretha ta gĩfaranja na kiĩhispania.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Na gũthira kwa mbaara ya faranja, Njĩrĩmani yajirie kwĩharĩria gũtharĩkĩra gĩcigĩrĩra kĩa Ngeretha
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: watho wa Njĩrĩmani weetire tharĩkĩra ĩno "Operation Sealion". makĩria ma matharaita manene na mabataro ma mbũtũ ya ngeretha nĩ moorĩte rĩrĩa mathamĩre kuuma Dunkirk, kwa ũguo mbũtũ ĩno yarĩ waagi wa hinya wa gathemba.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: no jesi ya maĩ-inĩ ya athamaki no yarĩ na hinya gũkĩra jesi ya maĩ-inĩ ya ũjirimani(Kriegsmarine) na yarĩ na ũhoti wa gũthũkangia tharĩkĩra o yothe ya kĩmakundi ĩrĩa ĩtũmĩtwo njĩra-inĩ ya ngeretha.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: o na kũrĩ ũguo meri cia kĩũthamaki ciahocetio hakuhĩ na njĩra iria ciarĩ na ũhotekeku wa tharĩkĩro nĩamu jesi ici nĩmetigagĩra no marĩkĩrio nĩ tharĩkĩro cia rĩera cia Njĩrĩmani.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Reke twambĩrĩrie na karugano kegiĩ mĩbango ya italy. Italy yarĩ "mũriũ wa ithe mũnini" wa Njĩrĩmani na Japan.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: yaarĩ na mbũtũ ĩtehotete hamwe na jesi cia maaĩ-inĩ matehotete, o na gũtuĩka makĩte o meri inya njerũ mbere ya kĩambĩrĩria kĩa haro.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: mĩoroto ĩrĩa ya bata ya Italy yarĩ mabũrũri ma Africa. nĩguo kũnyitũkia mabũrũri maya, nĩ ma bataragwo gũkorwo na pad ya kurehe thigari, nĩ getha thigari cihote kũringa iria rĩa Mediterranean na gũtharĩkĩra Africa
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: niũndũ ũcio, nĩ mabatarĩkanaga kũeheria base cia ngeretha na meri cia Misri. makĩria ma ciĩko ici, meri cia kĩharo cia Italy citiabatarĩtwo gũkinya handũ hangĩ o hothe.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: rĩu cia Japan.Japan warĩ bũrũri  ũrĩ gĩcigĩrĩra-inĩ o ta Britain
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: meri cia submarines cithodeketwo kũgerera maaĩ-inĩ na gũikara kuo kahinda karaihu.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: submarines ciahuthĩrirwo thĩ-inĩ wa mbaara ya mbere na ya keerĩ ya thĩ. ihinda-inĩ rĩu ni ciarutaga wĩra kahora hamwe na gũkorwo na ũhoti mũnini wa ũrathi.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ kĩa mbaara submarines ni ciageragĩra igũrũ wa iria no rĩrĩa radar yajĩrĩirie kwagĩra na kwaga mahĩtia nĩrio submarines ciatuĩkire no cithire thĩ wa maaĩ nĩ getha metheeme na kũonwo.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Meeri cia haaro cia Germany cietagwo U-boats. Ajerumani makoragwo marĩ ega mũno gũtwarithia na gũtũmĩra meeri ciao.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Nĩ ũndũ wa ũhotani wao na submarines, thutha wa haaro, Germans matiĩhokagwo gũkorwo na nyingĩ ciacio.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: ĩĩ! Mũthamaki Tutankhamun, rĩmwe wĩtagwo "mũthamaki Tut" kana "The Boy King" arĩ ũmwe wa athamaki a tene an Egypt moĩkaine mũno matukũ maya tũrĩ.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Kũgegania, ndamenyekanaga arĩ wa bata mũno matukũ macio ma tene na ndandĩkĩtwo harĩ mũrũmanĩrĩro wa arĩa mandĩkĩtwo marĩ athamaki a tene.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Ona kũrĩ ũguo, ũmenyekani wa mbĩrĩra yake mwaka wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana kenda ma mĩrongo ĩrĩ na igĩrĩ gũgĩtũma amenyekane mũno. Ona kũrĩ atĩ mbĩrĩra nyingĩ cia gatene nĩ ciaiyĩtwo, ĩno yatigĩtwo ĩkĩonekana ĩtathũkangĩtio.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Indo iria nyingĩ ciathikĩtwo na Tutankhamun nĩ ciamenyereirwo o wega, nginyagia makiri maingĩ ma matigari ma indo ciagwĩthondekera na Cuma cia bata na mahiga matarĩ moneki mũno.
