text: Ũtonga mũingĩ wa mbĩrĩra ĩyo ndũrĩ thĩ-inĩ wayo rĩngĩ, no nĩ weheretio ũgatwarwo Nyũmba-inĩ ya Kĩ-Mithiri ya Kũiga indo cia Kĩguucĩrĩrio kĩa Ũndũire kũu Cairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Ageni marĩ na ihinda ikundeeru no makorwo magĩĩka wega makĩria mangĩhũthĩra ihinda rĩao kũndũ kũngĩ.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, ĩrĩ kiromita ikũmi na igĩrĩ mũhuro wa ithuĩro rĩa Siem Reap. Hekarũ ĩno ĩrĩ kĩrĩma-inĩ yaakirwo mũthia-inĩ wa magana-inĩ ma mĩaka ya keenda, hĩndĩ ya ũthamaki wa mũthamaki Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Rĩera rĩtuku rĩa hekarũ na wĩroreri kuuma igũrũ rĩa iria rĩa Tonle Sap gũtũmaga kwambata kĩrĩma kũgĩe na bata.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Iceera rĩa gũthiĩ kũndũ kũu no rĩnyitithanio na njĩra ĩraingĩrana wega na thabarĩ ya gatarũ gũthiĩ iria-inĩ.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass nĩ ĩbatarĩkaga kũingĩra hekarũ na kwoguo ndũkariganĩrwo nĩ gũũka na marũa maku ma ũgendi hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũkwerekera Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalemu nĩguo mũciĩ mũnene na itũũra rĩrĩa inene rĩa Israel, o na gũtuĩka mabũrũri mangĩ maingĩ na Ũrũmwe wa Mabũrũri matirĩkũũranĩte ta mũciĩ mũnene wa Israel.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Itũũra rĩu rĩa tene rĩrĩ Irĩma-inĩ cia Judea rĩrĩ na rũgano rwa ũndũire warĩo wa magegania ũgĩtambũrũka makiri-inĩ ma mĩaka.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Itũũra rĩrĩ nĩ itheru kũrĩ ndini ithatũ iria ihooyaga ngai ũmwe-Judaism, Ũkristiano na Ithĩramu, na rĩheanaga ũtungata ta gĩtwe gĩa kiĩroho, ũndini, na ũndũire.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Nĩ ũndũ wa bata wa kĩ-ndini wa itũũra rĩrĩ, na mũno makĩria kũndũ kũingĩ gĩcigo-inĩ gĩa Itũũra rĩu rĩa Tene, Jerusalemu nĩ rĩmwe rĩa kũrĩa agendi meendete gũthiĩ thĩ-inĩ wa Israel.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalemu ĩkoragwo na kũndũ kũingĩ kwa maũndũ ma gĩ-tene, weenjeri wa maũndũ ma tene na ũndũire, hamwe na itwe cia thũgũrĩ thaka na ciyũrĩte andũ, mĩkawa ya kahũa, na mĩkawa ya irio.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Equador ĩbataraga raiya a Cuba maamũkĩre marũa ma kũmeeta mbere ya kũingĩra Equador kũgerera ihaaro cia ndege cia kĩ-mabũrũri kana kũndũ gwa kũhĩtũkĩria andũ mĩhaka-inĩ.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Marũa maya no nginya makorwo metĩkĩrĩtio kĩ-watho nĩ Rũhonge rwa Maundũ ma na Nja wa Bũrũri, na mahingie mabataro mana.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Mabataro maya mathondeketwo kũheana ũthaami ũbangĩtwo gũtherera wega gatagatĩ ka mabũrũri merĩ.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Aikari a Cuba arĩa meenyitĩire green card ya US maagĩrĩire maceerere ũbarũthi wa Equador nĩguo maamũkĩre kwehererio kũbatarĩka gũkũ.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Marũa maku ma ũgendi maagĩrĩire makorwo meetĩkĩrĩkĩte handũ-inĩ ha mĩeri ĩtanyihĩire ĩtandatũ gũkĩrũka tarĩki ciaku cia rũgendo nĩguo kuonania ũira wa ũraihu wa gũikara gwaku.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Thabarĩ cia ũgendi irĩ raithi kũrĩ ikundi nene, kwoguo ũngĩkorwo ũrĩ wika kana na mũrata o ũmwe, geria gũcemania na andũ angĩ na ũthondeke gĩkundi kĩa andũ ana nginya atandatũ nĩ ũndũ wa thogora mwegega wa o mũndũ.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: No ĩndĩ, ũyũ ndwagĩriire gũkorwo ũrĩ ũndũ ũtagwĩtanga naguo, tondũ kaingĩ agendi nĩmatukanagio nĩguo kũiyũria ngaari nini.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Kũrooneka ũrĩa kũrĩ nĩ atĩ nĩ njĩra ya kũhenereria andũ nĩguo meetĩkie atĩ no nginya marĩhe makĩria.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Kiraihĩire igũrũ rĩa mũthia wa rũgongo rwa Machu Picchu nĩ kĩrĩma gĩkĩ kĩinamu, kaĩngĩ gĩkoragwo kĩrĩ rũgito rwa kũhũũrĩra mbica nyingi cia mĩanangĩko ĩo.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Kĩonekaga kĩrĩ kĩritũ kuumana na thĩ, na nĩ kĩinamu na kĩritũ kwambata, no andũ aingĩ marĩ na mayũ maiganu nĩmaagĩrĩire kũhota gũkĩambata na ndagĩka ta 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Ikinyĩro cia mahiga ciarĩtwo hakuhĩ gacĩra goothe, na icigo iria nyinamu nguucio cia cuma nĩ iheanaga reli ya kũnyita na moko ya gwĩtiira.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Ũcio ũrĩ muuge, wĩrĩgĩrĩre ũhũũme, na menyerera icigo iria nyinamu, mũno makĩria rĩrĩa gwĩ kũigũ, tondũ no ituĩke ũgwati o narua.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Kũrĩ na gakurunga kanini hakuhĩ na gacũmbĩrĩ harĩa no nginya hatuĩkanĩrio, harĩ thĩ biũ na nĩ haceke hakundeeru.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Kwĩrorera kũndũ na nyamũ cia gĩthaka cia Galapagos gwĩkĩkaga wega ũkĩhũthĩra gatarũ, o ta ũrĩa Charles Darwin eekire mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana manana ma mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ithano.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Makĩria ma meeri mĩrongo ĩtandatũ cia mwago ithereragĩra maaĩ-inĩ ma Galapagos – igĩtigana harĩ mũigana kuuma athii anana nginya igana.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Andũ aingĩ magatagĩra handũ hao o mbere (tondũ tũtarũ tũkoragwo tũiyũrĩte hĩndĩ ĩrĩa kĩmera kĩrĩ igũrũ).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Korwo na ũũma atĩ mũramati ũrĩa ũragata kũhĩtũkĩra kũrĩ we nĩ mũũhĩgĩru wa Galapagos ũrĩ na ũmenyo mwega wa meeri mĩthemba mĩingĩ.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Ũndũ ũyũ ũgũtigĩrĩra atĩ maũndũ mana marĩa ũngĩenda na/kana mokundeeru nĩ maringithanio na meeri ĩrĩa yaganĩrĩire namo.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Mbere ya andũ a Spain makinye Magana-inĩ ma mĩaka ya ikũmi na ithathatũ, rũgongo rwa Chile rwarĩ rungu rwa wathani wa Inca hĩndĩ ĩrĩa aikari a kĩhumo gĩa kũu Araucanians (Mapuche) maikaraga gatagatĩ na mũhuro wa Chile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche ningĩ maarĩ amwe a ikundi cia mũthia cia aikari meyathĩte a kĩhumo kĩa America, arĩa mataameririo nĩ wathani wa aaria a Spanish o nginya thuutha wa wĩyathi wa Chile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: O na gũkorwo Chile nĩyatangathire wĩyathi mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri ĩmwe na magana manana ma ikũmi (gatagatĩ-inĩ ka mbaara cia kĩ-Napoleon iria ciatigire Spain ĩtarĩ na thirikari nene ĩraruta wĩra kwa ihinda rĩa mĩaka ĩĩrĩ), ũhootani wĩtwĩte wega igũrũ rĩa Spain ndwegwatĩirwo o nginya 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Republic ya Dominica (Spanish: Republica Dominicana) ni bũrũri wa Caribbean ũrĩa ũkoragwo nuthu-inĩ ya irathĩro island ya Hispaniola, mahakanite na Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Thengĩa icua cia mĩthanga mierũ na mĩarĩro ya ĩrĩma, bũrũri ũcio warĩ mũciĩ kũrĩ athũngũ arĩa a tene mũno Amerika, ĩrĩa rĩu rĩ thĩ-inĩ wa Santa Domingo
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Island  ĩyo yaikarĩtwo nĩ mĩhĩrĩga ya Ataino na Akaribe. Akaribe marĩ adũ maaragia mwario wa Arawakan arĩa makinyĩte kũu ĩhida rĩa 10,000 BCE
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: thĩ-inĩ wa mĩaka mĩnini kuuma gũkinya kwa mũthũngũ mũguturi, ũingĩ wa andũ wa mũhĩrĩga wa Atiaino nĩwanyihĩtio mũno nĩ Aspania atahi
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Kũringana na Fray Bartolomé las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) gatagatĩ ka mwaka wa 1492 na 1498 atahi a Spain nĩmoragĩte andũ ta 100,000 rũrĩrĩ-inĩ rwa Ataino.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Kĩwanja gĩkĩ gĩakirwo ta kĩwanja kĩa nyũmba kĩrĩ na ũtheri wa nja kĩrĩ kĩa mĩcemanio ya Magana-inĩ ma mĩaka ya ikũmi na mũgwanja, na harĩ kĩo Templo de San Diego no yo nyũmba ya mũmwe ĩtigarĩte.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Rĩu kĩrutaga wĩra ta kĩwanja kĩrĩa kĩnene kĩa mĩcemanio, na hĩndĩ ciothe nĩgĩkoragwo na maũndũ maingĩ marathiĩ na mbere.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Nĩ kũrĩ na mĩkawa ya irio ĩigana ũna ĩthiurũrũkĩirie kamũgũnda, na mathaa ma mĩaraho na hwaĩ-inĩ nĩ kũrĩ na moonanio matarĩhagĩrwo marĩa maheanagwo kuuma kĩĩgitio-inĩ kĩrĩa kĩnene.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Njĩra njeke ya Kĩmumunyo kĩu).  Nja igĩrĩ cia rũthingo-inĩ itigithũkanĩtio o na centimita 69 nĩ mũciĩ wa njorua ya tene ya wendo.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Ũrĩ na thendi nini ciana imwe no ikũganĩre rũgano rũu.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Gĩcigĩrĩra kĩa Bowen nĩ kũndũ kũrĩ igweta gwa kũũrĩra mũthenya ũmwe kana mũthia wa kiumia gũkĩheana gũtwarithia tũtarũ twa kayak, gũtuĩkania magũrũ, matuka, mĩkawa ya irio, na makĩria.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Kũndũ gũkũ kũrĩa gũtangĩĩkĩrĩrwo nganja gũkoragwo thĩ-inĩ wa Howe Sound hakuhĩ na Vanacouver, na gũkinyĩrĩkaga raithi na njĩra ya tegithi cia maaĩ-inĩ ibangĩtwo na mũtaratara ikiuma gĩcigĩrĩra kĩa Granile kĩanda wa Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kũrĩ arĩa makenagĩra maũndũ marĩa mekagwo kũndũ nja, gũtuĩkania magũrũ wambatanĩtie na iria nginya njĩra ya kũhĩtũkĩra ya Sky nĩ ũndũ ũrĩ na bata.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (handũ-inĩ ta ha ithaa rĩmwe na nuthu ũgĩtwarithia ngaari kuuma Vancouver) hatirĩ goro no nĩ hoĩkaine wega nĩ ũndũ wa Olympics cia hĩndĩ ya Heho cia mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na ikũmi.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Hĩndĩ ya heho, kenera ĩmwe ya mĩnyororoko ĩrĩa mĩega mũno ya mbarabu-inĩ thĩ-inĩ wa America ya Rũgongo, na hĩndĩ ya ũrũgari geria gũtwarithia kũhĩtũkie kwa baithikiri irĩma-inĩ.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Marũa ma kũheana rũũtha no nginya maigithio o mbere-inĩ. No nginya ũkorwo na marũa ma rũũtha nĩguo ũikare ũtukũ kũu Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena nokĩo gĩceceni kĩa aramati a mĩtitũ kĩrĩa kĩheanaga gwa gũkoma na irio hiũ hamwe na kwamba hema. La Leona, San Pedrillo, na Los Patos maheanaga o kwamba hema hatarĩ na ũtungata wa irio.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: No kũhoteke kwĩgĩĩra na marũa ma rũũtha ĩmwe kwa ĩmwe kuuma kũrĩ gĩceceni kĩa aramati a mĩtitũ kũu Puerto Jiménez, no matiĩtĩkagĩra kandĩ cia kũgũra na thiirĩ.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Ũtungata wa Rũnyanjara (MINAE) ndũheanaga marũa ma rũũtha rwa kũingĩra rũnyanjara-inĩ makĩrĩa ma mweri mbere ya gũkinya kũrĩa kwĩrĩgĩrĩirwo.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol nĩĩheanaga ũtungata wa kũigĩrwo na irĩhi rĩa US$30, or $10 nĩũndũ wa rũũtha rwa mũthenya ũmwe; ũhoro makĩria ũrĩ bĩnji-inĩ yao ya Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Icigĩrĩra cia Cook nĩ bũrũri wa gĩcigĩrĩra ũnyitanĩirwo na njĩra ya kwĩyendera na New Zealand, ũrĩ thĩ-inĩ wa Polynesia, gatagatĩ-inĩ ka Mũhuro wa Iria rĩa Pacific.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Nĩ gĩkundi gĩa icigĩrĩra ikũmi na ithano itambũrũkĩte handũ-inĩ ha makĩria ma ũraihu na wariĩ wa kiromita mirioni igĩrĩ gaturumo igĩrĩ cia iria.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Gũkorwo irĩ na gĩcigo kĩa mahinda kĩringaine na kĩa Hawaii, icigĩrĩra ici rĩmwe nĩciĩciragio ta arĩ cio"Hawaii ya mũhuro wa ikuĩta".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: O na gũkorwo nĩ nini hanini, nĩ ĩririkanagia ageni arĩa akũrũ a Hawaii mbere ya ĩtuĩkĩte bũrũri wĩyathĩte na ũtarĩ na maũndũ mothe ma mĩkawa mĩnene ya agendi na ũthii ũngĩ wa na mbere.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Icigĩrĩra cia Cook itirĩ na matũũra manene o mothe no ĩndĩ ikoragwo na icigĩrĩra 15 ngũũrani. Iria nene nĩ Rarotonga na Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Mabũrũri-inĩ marĩa mathiĩte na mbere ũmũthĩ, kũheana gĩtanda kĩega makĩria na irio cia rũci-inĩ nĩkwambatĩrĩtio nginya gĩkĩro kĩhaana ta ũcori.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Mũico-inĩ wa ikĩro cia igũrũ, B&Bs hatarĩ nganja icindanaga mũno harĩ maũndũ meerĩ manene: maũndũ megiĩ gĩtanda na irio cia rũci-inĩ.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Kũringana na ũguo, ikĩro-inĩ iria njunge mũno mĩkawa-inĩ ta ĩyo mũndũ no one gĩtanda kĩrĩa kĩngĩmũkenia mũno makĩria, kana hihi gĩtanda gĩa itambaya gĩthondeketwo na moko kana gĩtanda gĩa gĩ-tene.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Irio cia rũci-inĩ no ikorwo irĩ irio cia kĩmera iria ikenagia mũno andũ a gĩcigo kĩu kana irio cia mwanya ihaarĩrĩirio nĩ ũrĩa ũkũgwatĩte ũgeni.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Mũbangĩre wahota gũkorwo ũrĩ nyũmba-inĩ ngũrũ ya gĩ-tene ĩrĩ na mĩgemio ya gĩ-tene, iwanja irengereirwo wega na karia ga gwĩthambĩra.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kũingĩra ngaari-inĩ yaku na kwerekera thabarĩ barabara-inĩ ndaya gũkũheaga igucĩrĩria irikĩru nĩ ũndũ wa ũhũthũ wayo.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Ngũũrani na ngaari nene makĩria, waahota gũkorwo hihi nĩ ũmenyerete gũtwarithia ngaari yaku na ũkamenya mookundeeru mayo.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kwamba hema indo-inĩ cia mũndũ kĩũmbe kana itũũra-inĩ rĩa ũnene o wothe no kũgucĩrĩrie raithi ũrũmbũiya ũtangĩendeka.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Kwa njĩra nguhĩ, kũhũthĩra ngaari yaku nĩ njĩra njega ya gũthiĩ thabarĩ barabara-inĩ no yo nyene ti mũno ĩngĩkorwo ĩrĩ njĩra ya “kwamba hema”.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kwamba hema ngaari-inĩ nĩ kũhotekaga ũngĩkorwo na minivan nene, SUV, Sedan kana Station Wagon ĩrĩ na itĩ ingĩkoma.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Mĩkawa ĩmwe nĩ ĩgaĩte kuuma kũrĩ golden age ya reli iria ciahũthagĩra mĩrũkĩ na meeri nene cia ũkuui wa andũ iria-inĩ; mbere ya Mbaara ya Thĩ ya Kerĩ, Magana-inĩ ma mĩaka ya ikũmi na keenda kana kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ kĩa magana-inĩ ma mĩaka ya mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Mĩkawa-inĩ ĩno nĩkuo itonga na arĩa maarĩ igweta matukũ-inĩ macio maikaraga, na kaingĩ makoragwo na mũtũũrĩre mwega mũno wa kũrĩa na wa ũtukũ.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Tũnyamũ twa kuoha tũhĩtũke nĩ mahinda, gũkorwo gũtarĩ na indo cia kũhũthĩra cia kĩ-rĩu, na ũkũrũ mũna ũrĩ na ũthaka nĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩa maũthĩ macio.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: O na harĩa ikoragwo irĩ cia andũ kĩũmbe, hĩndĩ ĩmwe na ĩngĩ nĩinyitaga ũgeni atongoria a mabũrũri na andũ angĩ a gũtĩĩka.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Mũgendi ũrĩ na hĩba cia mbeca no ecirie kũgĩa na rũgendo rwa ndege ya gũthiũrũrũka thĩ yothe, agakĩmĩtwĩkĩria haha na harĩa na njĩra ya gũikara thĩ-inĩ wa mĩingĩ ya mĩkawa ĩno.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Rũgendo rwa gũkũũrania ũtugi nĩ mũbango ũthondeketwo wa kũnyitithania agendi na aikari a matũũra marĩa megũceerera.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kwĩnyitithania na rũrenda ta rũu kaingĩ kũbataraga o ũiyũrie bomu ĩrĩ rũrenda-inĩ; o na gũtuĩka nenda imwe iheanaga kana ikabatara gwĩkĩrwo mũkonde makĩria.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Maandĩko magwetete anyitani ũgeni arĩa marĩ kuo macokaga makaneanwo na njĩra ĩcabithĩtio na/ kana rũrenda-inĩ, hĩndĩ ĩmwe na ĩngĩ marĩ na kwĩranĩra na mawoni ma gũcokeria mekĩtwo nĩ agendi angĩ.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Ũtungata wa gũkũũrania ũhoro nenda-inĩ wa kũrĩa ũngĩona gwa gũikara waambĩrĩirio Mweri-inĩ wa Mbere wa mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na inya thuutha wa mũthondeki wa mũtaratara wa kambiuta wa kũruta wĩra Casey Fenton kuona rũgendo rwa ndege rwa raithi gũthiĩ Iceland no akĩaga kũndũ gwa gũikara.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Agĩtũma e-mail kũrĩ arutwo a cukuru ya gĩthomo kĩa igũrũ ya kũu na akĩamũkĩra meendekithia maingĩ mũno makĩĩranĩra kũheana gwa gũikara hatarĩ marĩhi.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Nyũmba cia gũkoma cirũmbũyagia mũno andũ ethĩ- mũgeni akoragwo arĩ mĩaka-inĩ ya mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ – no kaingĩ no wone agendi akũrakũrũ marĩ kũu.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Bamĩrĩ irĩ na ciana itionekaga mũno, no nyũmba imwe cia gũkoma itimetĩkagĩria maingĩre ithaku cia andũ kĩũmbe.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Itũũra inene rĩa Beijing kũu China rĩgakorwo rĩrĩ itũũra rĩrĩa rĩkanyita ũgeni Mathako ma Olympic ma hĩndĩ ya heho mwaka-inĩ wa ngiri igĩrĩ na mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na igĩrĩ, na ũndũ ũyũ ũgatũma rĩtuĩke itũũra rĩa mbere kũnyitana ũgeni hĩndĩ ya Olympics cierĩ cia hĩndĩ ya riũa na hĩndĩ ya heho.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing nĩ ĩkanyitana ũgeni harĩ maambura ma kũhingũra na kũhinga na mathako-inĩ ma mbarabu marĩa mathakagĩrwo thĩ-inĩ wa nyũmba.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Mathako ma kũnyororoka mbarabu-inĩ magakorwo Taizicheng ski thĩ-inĩ wa Zhangjiakou, arĩ nĩ ta kiromita magana meerĩ na mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ (mairo igana rĩa mĩrongo ĩna) kuuma Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Hekarũ nyingĩ ikoragwo na gĩathĩ kĩa o Mwaka kĩrĩa kĩambagĩrĩria mũthia-inĩ wa Mweri wa Ikũmi na Ũmwe o nginya Mweri wa Gatano Gatagatĩ-inĩ, kĩrĩa kĩo gĩkoragwo na ngũũrani kũringana na karenda ya mwaka ya o hekarũ.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Nyingĩ cia ciathĩ ici cia hekarũ ikũngũyagĩrwo ta gĩcunjĩ gĩa kũhingia mwaka wa hekarũ kana mũthenya wa gũciarwo wa ngai ĩrĩa ĩrĩ gĩtĩ-inĩ kana ũndũ ũngĩ mũnene wĩtanĩtio na hekarũ.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Ciathĩ cia heharũ ya Kerala nĩ kĩgucĩrĩrio kenene gĩa kwĩrorera, gĩkoragwo na mũthabara wa njogu igemetio, gĩkundi kĩa aini na ahũũri a indo cia kũina kĩa hekarũ na ciathĩ ingĩ.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Monanio ma thĩ yothe (marĩa mũno metagwo World Exposition, kana na njĩra hũthũ Expo) nĩ gĩathĩ kĩnene gĩa kĩ-mabũrũri kĩa wara wa ũturi na maũndũ ma sayansi.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Mabũrũri marĩa maranyitanĩra monanagia maũndũ megiĩ wara wa ũturi na ma gĩthomo hema-inĩ cia bũrũri makĩonania maũndũ megiĩ thĩ kana ũndũire na maũndũ ma tene megiĩ bũrũri wao.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Moonanio ma kĩ-mabũrũri ma ũrĩmi wa Horticulture nĩ maũndũ ma mwanya marĩa monanagia cionanio cia mahũa, tũmĩgũnda twa mĩmera na kĩndũ kĩngĩ o gĩothe kĩhutanĩtie na mĩmera.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: O na gũtuĩka maũndũ maya meerĩkanaga no mekwo o mwaka (o kũngĩkorwo marĩ mabũrũri-inĩ matiganĩte), matiĩkagwo na ciĩko.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Maũndũ maya kaingĩ maikaraga handũ o hothe gatagatĩ-inĩ ka mĩeri ĩtatu na ĩtandatũ, na meekagĩrwo handũ hatanyihĩire hekita mĩrongo ĩtano.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Nĩ kũrĩ na mĩthemba mĩingĩ ya mĩkwa ĩrĩa yanahũthĩka kahinda-inĩ ka mĩaka. Mũkwa wa gĩthimi kĩrĩa gĩĩtĩkĩrĩku makĩria ya mirimita mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ithano (karimũ ka ũraihu na wariĩ  wa mirimita mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ithano na mirimita mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na inya) nĩguo wonekaga muno.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: No yoongererwo na njĩra hũthũ makĩria ũngĩmĩnina, na nĩĩheanaga ũnyoroku wa rangi ũngĩringithanio gũkuhĩrĩria wa DSLR ya kĩĩrĩu.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Kamera imwe iria ihũhũthĩra mũkwa wa mũthemba wa  gatagatĩ-inĩ  nĩihũthagĩra mũthemba wa ũraihu na wariĩ  wa centimita ithathatũ na centimita ithathatũ, kuuga wega makĩria nĩ karimũ ka ũraihu na wariĩ wa mirimita mĩrongo ĩtano na ithathatũ na mirimita mĩrongo ĩtano na ithathatũ
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Ũndũ ũyũ ũheanaga ũnyoroku wa rangi wa hakuhĩ maita mana ma karimũ ka mirimita mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ithano (ũraihu na wariĩ wa mirimita ngiri ithatũ na igana rĩa mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ithathatũ kũringithanio na magana manana ma mĩrongo ĩtandatũ na inya).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Nyamũ cia gĩthaka nĩcio indo cia kũhũũrwo mbica iria nditũ mũno kũrĩ mũhũũri mbica, na ibataraga mũtukanio wa mũnyaka mwega, ũkirĩrĩria, ũmenyeru na mĩtambo mĩega.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Ũhũũri mbica wa nyamũ cia gĩthaka kaingĩ woyagwo o ũguo raithi, no o ta ũhũũri mbica ũrĩa ũkoragwo kuo kaingĩ, mbica ĩrĩ thogora wa ciugo ngiri.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Ũhũũri mbica wa nyamũ cia gĩthaka kaingĩ wendaga icicio ndaya cia kamera ya kuoya mbica nene ya kĩndũ kĩrĩ kũraaya, o na gũtuĩka indo ta gĩkundi kĩa nyoni kana tũnyamũ tũnini ibataraga icicio ingĩ.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Nyamũ nyingĩ cia kũreehwo kuuma na nja irĩ hinya mũno kuona, na parks hĩndĩ ĩwe na ĩngĩ nĩ ikoragwo na mawatho megiĩ kũhũũra mbica nĩ ũndũ wa itũmi cia kĩ-biacara.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Nyamũ cia gĩthaka ciahota kũigua thoni kana ciende kũrũra. Kũrĩa gũthiũrũkĩirie kwahota gũkorwo kũrĩ kũhehu, kũhiũ, kana rĩngĩ gũtiraikarĩka.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Thĩ ĩkoragwo na thiomi ngũũrani makĩria ma ngiri ithano, na nĩ hamwe na makĩria ma mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ o hamwe na mirioni mĩrongo ĩtano kana makĩria cia arĩa maciaragia.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Ciugo cia kwandĩkwo kaingĩ nĩ hũthũ gũtaũkĩrwo gũkĩra ciugo cia kwario. Ũndũ ũyũ nĩ wa ma mũno makĩria ũhoro-inĩ wa andirethi, iria kaingĩ ikoragwo irĩ hinya kũgweta na njĩra ĩraiguĩka..
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Mabũrũri maingĩ o ta ũrĩa maigana mothe nĩmahotaga kwaria gĩthũngũ wega, o na nginya kũrĩa ũngĩĩrĩgĩrĩra makorwo na ũkundeeru wa kũmenya - mũno gatagatĩ-inĩ ka andũ ethĩ.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Ta wĩcũranie, ũngĩenda, mũndũ wa Manchuria, mũndũ wa Boston, mũndũ wa Jamaica na wa Sydney maikarĩte mathiũrũkĩirie metha makĩrĩa irio cia hwaĩ-inĩ mũkawa-inĩ ũrĩ Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Marakenania mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ na ng’ano kuuma matũũra ma kwao, magĩciheana na mĩarĩrie ĩĩkũũraine na mĩarĩrie mĩhithe ya gĩ-kwao.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kũgũra irio matuka-inĩ manene kaingĩ nĩyo njĩra ĩrĩa ya raithi makĩria ya kwĩhe irio.Hatarĩ na mĩeke ya kũruga, maũndũ marĩa ũngĩthuura makuunderaga magatigara tu o irio iria irĩkĩtie kũrugwo.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Matuka manene nĩmarathiĩ na mbere na kũgĩa na kũndũ ngũũrani kũigĩtwo irio irĩkĩtie kũrugwo. Mamwe mamo nginya nĩmaheanaga riiko rĩa thitima rĩa kũruga na mĩrũri kana njĩra ingĩ cia kũhiũhia irio.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Mabũrũri-inĩ mamwe kana mĩthemba ya matuka nĩgũkoragwo na mũkawa ũtanyihĩire ũmwe ũrĩ o hau hakuhĩ.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Thondeka na ũkuue kobĩ cia mũbango waku wa icorethi na ũkorwo na njĩra cia gũgũteithia gũkinyĩra ũrĩa ũkũheete icorethi.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Irabatara gũkorwo ikĩonania kĩerekeria kĩa ndũmĩrĩri rũrenda-inĩ ya mũheani icorethi na namba cia thimũ cia kĩ-mabũrũri nĩguo kwamũkĩra ũtaari/kũheo rũũtha na gwĩtia marĩhi ma icorethi.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Korwo na kobĩ ĩngĩ mũrigo-inĩ waku na rũrenda-inĩ (wĩtũmĩre ndũmĩrĩri rũrenda-inĩ ĩrĩ na njoherera ya kobĩ, kana ĩigwo thĩ-inĩ wa "handũ ha kũiganĩra indo hamwe rũrenda-inĩ").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Ũngĩkorwo thabarĩ-inĩ na wĩ na laptop kana tablet, iga kobĩ thĩ-inĩ wa memory kana disc (ĩngĩthomeka hatarĩ nenda cia ũkinyanĩria).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Ningĩ neana kobĩ cia policy/contract kũrĩ arĩa mwĩ thabarĩ-inĩ nao na arĩa mwĩtainwo kana arata arĩa me mũciĩ mangĩenda gũteithia.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Thwariga iria nene (irĩa ningĩ ciũĩkaine ta elk) itikoragwo irĩ na ũrũrũ, no nĩ cikwĩgitĩra ingĩigua ta kũrĩ na ũgwati.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ matekuona thwariga ĩrĩa nene ta ingĩkorwo irĩ ũgwati, maahota gũcikuhĩrĩria makĩria na meikie ũgwati-inĩ.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Ũnyue inyuuo cia njoohi ũrĩ na ngerero. Njoohi ĩhuutagia o mũndũ na njĩra ngũũrani, na kũmenya gĩthimi gĩaku nĩ ũndũ wa bata mũno.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Mathĩĩna ma ũgima wa mwĩrĩ ma ihinda iraaya marĩa mangĩoneka maumanĩte na ũnyui ũtarĩ gĩthimi maahota gũkorwo nĩ hamwe na gũthũka kwa ini o na nginya ũtumumu na gĩkuũ. Ũgwati ũrĩa ũngĩoneka nĩ wongererekaga hĩndĩ ĩrĩa wanyua njoohi ĩthondeketwo na njĩra ĩtarĩ njĩtĩkĩrie.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Njoohi cia ibango itarĩ njĩtĩkĩrie no ikorwo na gĩko kĩa mĩthemba kĩrĩ na ũgwati arĩ hamwe na methanol, ĩrĩa ĩngĩrehe ũtumumu kana gĩkuũ o na ĩnyuĩtwo kanini kanini.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Macicio no makorwo marĩ raithi bũrũri-inĩ mũgeni, mũno makĩria mabũrũri-nĩ marĩa makoragwo na mĩcaara mĩnini o kũrĩa mathogora ma ũruti wĩra nĩ manini.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Wĩcirie ũhoro wa kũgĩa na kĩgerio kĩa maitho ũrĩ mũciĩ, mũno makĩria kũngĩkorwo icorethi nĩĩrarũgamĩrĩra, na ũũke na irũa rĩa ndawa iria wandĩkĩirwo ũgacioere kũndũ kũngĩ.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Buremu cia ikĩro cia igũrũ na rĩĩtwa rĩrĩ igweta iria cionekaga kũndũ ta kũu ciahota gũkorwo na mathĩĩna meerĩ; imwe no ikorwo irĩ cia maigĩrĩra, na iria cia ma ireehetwo kuuma na nja ciahota gũkorwo irĩ na goro makĩria gũkĩra cia mũciĩ.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kahũa nĩ kĩmwe kĩa indo iria ithogoragwo mũno thĩ-inĩ wa thĩ, na wahota hihi kuona mĩthemba mĩingĩ gĩcigo-inĩ gĩa kwanyu.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: O na kũrĩ o ũguo, nĩ kũrĩ njĩra nyingĩ ngũũrani cia kũnyua kahũa thĩ guothe iria irĩ bata gũciĩiguĩra.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (kana canyoneering) nĩ ũhoro na gũikũrũka nginya gĩtina-inĩ kĩa mũkuru mũnene, ũrĩa no ũkorwo ũrĩ mũũmũ kana ũiyũire maaĩ.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning kũnyitithanagia maũndũ ma gũthambĩra, kũhamba na kũrũga-no gũtibataraga kũrutwo kũnene kana mayũ ma mwĩrĩ nĩguo ũhote kwambĩrĩria (gũkĩringithanio na kũhamba ndwaro-inĩ cia mahiga, gwĩka kĩĩhindiĩ maaĩ-inĩ kana kũnyororoka mbarabu-inĩ cia alpine, kwa mũhiano).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Iceera rĩa gũtuĩkania na magurũ nĩ ũndũ wĩkĩkaga kũndũ nja arĩ nĩ hamwe na gũceeranga kũndũ kwa ndũire kũrĩa gũtũthiũrũrũkĩirie, mũno makĩria njĩra-inĩ iria ituĩkanagĩrio na magũrũ.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Iceera rĩa gũtuĩkania na magũrũ rĩa mũthenya-inĩ rĩkoragwo rĩrĩ rĩa gĩtĩna kĩnini kũrĩ mairo ĩmwe o nginya gĩtĩna kĩnene makĩria kĩrĩa kĩngĩthiio handũinĩ ha mũthenya mũgima.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Iceera rĩa gũtuĩkania na magũrũ rĩa mũthenya kũhĩtũkĩra njĩra hũthũ rĩbataraga meeharĩrĩria manini, na mũndũ o wothe ũrĩ na mayũ ma gatagatĩ-inĩ no amakenerere.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Bamĩrĩ iria irĩ na twana tũnini no ibatare meeharĩrĩria makĩria, no gũkorwo nja mũthenya ũmwe no ũhoteke raithi o na ũrĩ na ciana cia ngenge na ciana itathiĩte cukuru.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Kĩ-mabũrũri, gũkoragwo ikundi thondeke cia ũgendi wa guteng’era ikuhĩrĩirie magana meerĩ. Nyingĩ ciacio irutaga wĩra na wĩyathi.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Kambũni ĩrĩa yokire thuutha wa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours ĩnyitithanagia dathani nyingĩ cia aheani a ũteng'eri wa gũtarĩria kuuma itarũ inya.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Irĩ na mĩri thĩ-inĩ wa Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona na Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen,nĩyanyitanire narua na Running Tours Prague ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo Prague na ingĩ.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Kũrĩ na maũndũ maingĩ ũrĩ o nginya wĩcirie mbere na hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũrathiĩ thabarĩ ya handũ.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũgũthiĩ thabarĩ, wĩrĩgĩrĩre maũndũ gũkorwo matarĩ ũrĩa makoragwo “kũrĩa mũciĩ”. Mĩtugo, mawatho, irio, ũingĩ wa ngaari, gwa gũkoma, ikĩro, rũthiomi na mangĩ ta macio megũkorwo marĩ ngũũrani na gĩkĩro kĩna makĩringithanio na kũrĩa ũikaraga.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ũyũ nĩ ũndũ ũrabatara kũiga meciria-inĩ hĩndĩ ciothe, kũgirĩrĩria kũũragwo ngoro kana hihi nginya kũnyarara ũrĩa maũndũ mekagwo kũndũ kũu.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Aramati a thabarĩ makoretwo kuo kuuma magana-inĩ ma mĩaka ya ikũmi na keenda. Mũramati wa thabarĩ kaingĩ akoragwo arĩ mwega kũmũthuura nĩũndũ wa rũgendo rũrakĩra ũrĩa mũgendi amenyerete ũhoro-inĩ wa ũndũire wa marĩa matũrigicĩirie, mĩtugo ya ndũire, rũthiomi kana mabũrũri marĩa makoragwo na mĩcaara mĩnini.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: O na gũtuĩka ikũndi nyingĩ cia ũramati nĩciendaga kuoya maũndũ marĩa maingĩ ma ũgati, aramati aingĩ moorotagĩrĩria mĩthemba mĩna ya ũgendi, mũbango wa mahũthĩro na kũrĩa kũrathio.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: No gũkorwo arĩ wega makĩria kũhũthĩra mũramati ũrĩa ũgatagĩra maita maingĩ thabarĩ ihaana ta icio ciaku.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Rora nĩ thabarĩ irĩkũ mũramati ũcio aragathĩrĩria, kana nĩ rũrenda-inĩ kana nĩ ndirica-inĩ ya nduka.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Ũngĩenda kuona kũrĩa kũrĩ na maũndũ ma raithi thĩ ĩno, harĩ mabataro, mũikarĩre kana irũithia, nĩ harĩ njĩra ciigana ũna cia gwĩka ũguo.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Ũndũ wa bata, ikoragwo ibangĩtwo na njĩra igĩrĩ: No ũrute wĩra hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũrathiĩ thabarĩ kana ũgerie gũthima mahũthĩro maku. Koohoro gaka kaandĩke koorotereirie ũndũ ũcio wa thuutha.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Kũrĩ arĩa magĩenda kwĩima kũiganĩra kwao, mathaa na kwĩrĩgĩrĩrĩka gũtindĩka mahũthĩro na thĩ makuhĩrĩrie kĩbũgũ, rora thabarĩ ya mũbango wa mahũthĩro ũrĩa mũnini mũno.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Kũrĩ arĩa mangĩenda kwĩima kũiganĩra kwao, mathaa na kwĩrĩgĩrĩrĩka gũtindĩka mahũthĩro na thĩ makuhĩrĩrie kĩbũgũ, rora thabarĩ ya mũbango wa mahũthĩro ũrĩa mũnini mũno.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Handũ ha kũberegenyera athaami kaingĩ hakoragwo nĩho handũ ha mbere ũrũgamaga waarĩkia kuuma ndege-inĩ, meeri, kana ngaari ĩngĩ.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Thĩ-inĩ wa mĩĩgithi ĩmwe ĩrĩa ĩtuĩkanagia mĩhaka-inĩ ya mabũrũri ũthuthuria wĩkagwo kũrĩ mũũgithi ũrĩa ũrathiĩ na wagĩrĩire gũkorwo na ID njĩtĩkĩrĩku hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũraingĩra ũmwe wa mĩĩgithi ĩo.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Thĩ-inĩ wa mĩĩgithi ya ũtukũ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na gwa gũkoma, marũa ma ũgendi no moonganio nĩ mũgatithia nĩgetha toro waku ndũgatuĩkĩrio.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Wĩyandĩkithia nĩ ũndũ ũngĩ wendekanaga harĩ mũtaratara wa marũa ma ũthaami. Mabũrũri-inĩ mamwe, no nginya wandĩkithie kũrĩ aathani a kũu ũhoro wĩgiĩ gũkorwo ho gwaku na njĩra cia gũgũkinyĩra kũrĩa ũraikara.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Ũndũ ũyũ wahota kũbatara kũiyũria bomu borithi-inĩ ya kũu kana ũcerere wabici cia ũthaami.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Mabũrũri-inĩ maingĩ kũrĩa kũrĩ watho ta ũcio, mĩkawa ya kũu nĩĩrutaga wĩra ũcio wa kwandĩkithia (tigĩrĩra nĩ woria).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Hĩndĩ ĩngĩ, no arĩa maikaraga nja ya kũrĩa agendi makomaga mabataraga kwĩyandĩkithia. No rĩrĩ, ũndũ ũyũ ũtũmaga watho ũhithĩke makĩria, kwoguo twĩria mbere.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Ũcori wa manyũmba nĩ ũhoro wĩgiĩ mũbango na mwako wa manyũmba. Ũcori wa manyũmba ma kũndũ kaingĩ nĩĩgucagĩrĩria agendĩ o na ĩrĩ iika.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Manyũmba maingĩ nĩ mathaka mũno kũmeerorera na kuoneka kwamo kuuma nyũmba-inĩ ndaya kana kuuma ndirica ĩigĩtwo handũ na njĩra ya ũũgĩ no ũkorwo ũrĩ ũthaka wa kwĩrorerwo.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Mĩako nĩĩrĩanaga mũno makĩria na mĩena ĩngĩ ta mũvango wa kisio, ũturi wa mĩako ya kũguna mũingĩ, wara wa kũgemia, ũthondeki wa kũndũ thĩ-inĩ na ũthondeki wa kũndũ nja gwa gũikara.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa maingĩ ma pueblos makoragwo marĩ kũndũ kũraihĩrĩirie, ndũkũhota kuona mũigana mũnene wa maica ma ũtukũ hatarĩ gũthiĩ Albuquerque kana Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: No ningĩ, nyũmba ciothe cia gũũtha kamarĩ ici cionanĩtio haha igũrũ nĩciendagia inyuuo, na nyingĩ ciacio irehage maũndũ ma ikeno me na rĩĩtwa inene (mũno makĩria iria nene ithiũrũrũkĩirie hakuhĩ na Albuquerque na Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Wĩmenyerere: baa cia tũtũũra tũnini cia gũkũ itikoragwo hĩndĩ ciothe irĩ kũndũ kwega kwa mũgeni uumĩte nja ya gĩcigo kĩu kuumĩra gwĩkeneria kuo.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Ũndũ ũmwe kũrĩ, New Mexico ya rũgongo nĩ ĩrĩ na mathĩĩna maingĩ megiĩ andũ gũtwarithia ngaari marĩ arĩu, na ũingĩ wa matereba arĩu wĩ igũrũ hakuhĩ na baa cia tũtũũra tũnini.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Mĩcoro ĩtakwendekana kana mĩthigitho yũĩkaine ta graffiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: O na gũkorwo nĩ ũndũ ũraihĩrĩirie magegania ma-kĩrĩu, andũ aingĩ kwahoteka maũtaranagĩria na ũndũ wa andũ ethĩ magĩthũkangia indo cia mũingĩ na cia andũ kĩũmbe makĩhũthĩra rangĩ wa kũhuhĩra.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: No ĩndĩ, matukũ maya nĩkũrĩ andũ me na wara mũhahandĩku wa graffiti, maũndũ marĩa mekĩkaga ma graffiti na thingo cia “kĩwatho”. Marangi mahake ma graffiti na ũtauku ũyũ kaingĩ mahaanaga wĩra wa wara wa ũturi gũkĩra indo itarathomeka.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Gũikia kĩgũtha kĩragũcookerera nĩ wĩra wĩ na ũũhĩgĩru ũĩkaine ũrĩa agendi aingĩ mendaga kũgĩa naguo.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Ũngĩenda kwĩruta gũikia kĩgũtha kĩragũcookerera guoko-inĩ gwaku, tigĩrĩra atĩ ũrĩ na kĩgũtha kĩracookerera.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Igũtha nyingĩ cia gũcookerera iria cionekaga thĩ-inĩ wa Autralia ikoragwo kwaria ma itarĩ cia gũcookerera. Nĩ wega makĩria kũrĩ arĩa maraambĩrĩria matikagerie gũikia kwĩ na rũhuho.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Irio cia Hangi irugagĩrwo thĩ-inĩ wa irima ihiu rĩrĩ tĩĩri-inĩ.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Irima rĩu rĩhiũhagio na mahiga mahiũ kana kuumana na mwaki, kana kũndũ kũmwe ũrugarĩ wa gũkunũka kuumana na thĩ ũtũmaga icigo cia tĩĩri ihiũhe kĩ-ndũire.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi kaingĩ ĩhũthagĩrwo kũruga irio cia hwaĩ-inĩ cia mũthemba wa njino ya kĩ-ndũire.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Kũndũ kũingĩ thĩ-inĩ wa Rotorua kũheanaga hangi ya geothermal, nacio hangi ingĩ no ĩcagũrwo thĩ-inĩ wa Christchurch, Wellington na kũndũ kũngĩ.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail ĩrĩ irathi igĩrĩ cia mĩĩgithi ya gũkuua andũ thĩ-inĩ na gũthiũrũrũka Cape Town: MetroPlus (ĩrĩa ningĩ ĩĩtagwo First Class) na Metro (ĩĩtagwo Third Class).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus nĩ hooreru na ndĩtutumanĩrĩirwo mũno no nĩ ya goro makĩria, no nĩĩkoragwo ĩrĩ ya raithi gũkĩra tigiti wa kawainda wa metro thĩ-inĩ wa Rũraya.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Mũũgithi o wothe nĩũkoragwo na makũmbĩ meerĩ ma MetroPlus na Metro; Makũmbĩ ma MetroPlus makoragwo mũthia-inĩ wa mũgithi ũrĩa ũkuhĩrĩirie Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Gũkuuĩra arĩa angĩ-Ndũkanareke mondo ciaku cieherio kuuma harĩa ũraciona, mũno makĩria hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũrakĩra mĩhaka ya kĩ-mabũrũri.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: No wĩkore ukĩhũthĩrwo ta mũkuui wa ndawa cia kũrebia ũtekũmenya, ũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩgũikia thĩĩna-inĩ mũnene mũno.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Ũndũ ũyũ nĩ hamwe na gweterera mũhari-inĩ, tondũ ngui cia kũnungĩra ndawa cia kũrebia no ihũthĩke hĩndĩ o yothe hatarĩ kĩmenyithia.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Mabũrũri mamwe makoragwo na mahera mooru mũno nginya kũrĩ mahĩtia ma riita rĩa mbere; marĩa no makorwo marĩ cioho cia njeera cia makĩria ma miaka 10 kana gĩkuũ.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Mondo itararũmbũiyo nĩciorotagĩrĩrio kũiywo na no ciguucĩrĩrie aathani marehũga mogwati ma bomu.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Ũrĩ mũciĩ, nĩ ũndũ wa gũikara ũgĩikagio ũgwati-inĩ wa njamuthi cia kũu, ũhotekeku nĩ atĩ nĩ ũrĩkĩtie kwĩyũmia kũrĩ cio.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Ĩndĩ mĩena-inĩ ĩngĩ ya thĩ, kũrĩa tũnyamũ mũthemba wa mbakitĩria nĩ tũgeni kũrĩ we, wahota mũno makĩria kũingĩra mathĩĩna-inĩ.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Ningĩ, kũrĩa kũrĩ rĩera ihiũ mbakitĩria nĩ ikũraga narua makĩria na igatũũra mũno irĩ nja wa mwĩrĩ.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Na nĩkĩo njamiũ cia iherithia cia Delhi Belly, Kĩrumi kĩa Firaũni, Kwĩrĩhĩria kwa Montezuma, na arata aingĩ aao.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: O ta ũrĩa gũkoragwo ũhoro-inĩ wa mathĩĩna ma kũhuhia kũndũ kũrĩa kũhehu, mathĩĩna ma nda kũndũ kũrĩa kũhiũ nĩmonekaga mũno na kaingĩ makoragwo marĩ ma kũrakaria no matikoragwo marĩ ũgwati wa biũ.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Ũngĩkorwo ũgĩthiĩ rũgendo bũrũri-inĩ ũrakũra rĩrĩ ihinda rĩaku rĩa mbere – kana kũndũ kũgeni thĩ-ĩno-ndũkahũthie ũhotekekeku wa imakania cia ũndũire.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Agendi aingĩ mehandĩte, na marĩ na ũhoti manahootwo nĩ ũgeni wa ũgendi wa thĩ ĩrakũra, kũrĩa tũmoogarũrũku tũingĩ tũnini twa ũndũire twahota kwĩyonganĩrĩria narua.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Mũno makĩria matukũ-inĩ maku ma kĩambĩrĩria, wĩcirie ũhoro wa gũitanga mbeca mĩkawa-inĩ ya mũthemba wa Rũraya –ya ikĩro cia igũru, irio, na mootungata nĩguo igũteithie kũmenyera.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Ndũgakome muuto-inĩ kana kamuuto kaarĩtwo thĩ kũndũ kũrĩa ũtoĩ nyamũ cia kuo.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Ũngĩkorwo nĩ ũkwamba hema nja, reehe gatanda kairigĩre kana gĩtanda kĩa mũcuuha nĩguo wĩtheeme na nyoka, tũng’aurũ na ingĩ ta icio.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Iyũria mũciĩ waku na kahũa gacamu rũci-inĩ na cai ũrakũhooreria wa chamomile ũtukũ.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Rĩrĩa ũrĩ iceera rĩrĩ gwaku mũciĩ, ũrĩ na ihinda rĩa gwĩthondeka na indo njega na woe ndagĩka ingĩ ciigana ũna gũtukania kĩndũ kĩa mwanya.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Ũngĩkorwo nĩ ũraigua ta ũkwenda kũgeria indo njerũ makĩria, oya kamweke ũthondeke maaĩ ma matunda kana ũtukanie smoothies:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Kwahoteka nĩ ũkũhumbũra gĩa kũnyua tiga maaĩ kĩrĩa ũngĩthondeka kĩa irio cia rũci-inĩ wacokerera maũndũ marĩa wĩkaga o mũthenya.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Ũngĩkorwo ũikaraga itũũra-inĩ inene rĩrĩ na mĩthemba ya ũndũire wa kũnyua, thiĩ baa kana pambu matũũra-inĩ marĩa marigicĩirie kũrĩa ũtathiaga mũno.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Kũrĩ arĩa matamenyeranĩte na ciugo nditũ cia ũrigitani, ciugo cia infectious na contagious maugaga maũndũ ngũũrani.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Mũrimũ infectious nĩ ũrĩa ũrehagwo nĩ pathogen, ta bairathi, mbakitĩriamu, fungus kana parasite ingĩ.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Mũrimũ contagious nĩ mũrimu ũrĩa ũngĩtambio raithi na njĩra ya gũkorwo ũkuhĩrĩirie mũndũ mũrũarũ
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Thirikari nyingĩ nĩcibataraga ageni makĩingĩra, kana aikari makiuma mathiĩ, mabũrũri mao mathecwo njanjo nĩ ũndũ wa mĩrimũ ĩigana ũna.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Mabataro maya kaingĩ maahota kũringana na mabũrũri marĩa ũrĩa ũrathiĩ rũgendo akoretwo aceereire kana aratanya gũceerera.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Ũndũ ũmwe wa hinya wa Chalotte, Carolina ya Rũgongo, nĩ atĩ nĩ ĩrĩ na ũingĩ wa maũndũ  ma gĩkĩro kĩa igũrũ ma bamĩrĩ gũcagũra kuuma kũrĩ mo.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Aikari a kuuma kũndũ kũngĩ kaingĩ nĩ magwetaga ũhoro wa kwendana kwa bamĩrĩ ta arĩ kĩo gĩtũmi kĩnene gĩa gũthiĩ kũndũ kũu, na ageni kaingĩ nĩ moonaga itũũra rĩu rĩrĩ ihũthũ kũrĩkenera mũrĩ hamwe na ciana.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Handũ-inĩ ha mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ mĩhĩtũku, mũigana wa maundũ marĩa ũngĩthuura ma gũkenia ciana kũu Uptown Charlotte nĩ ũkũrĩte na njĩra nene.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Tegithi itihũthĩkaga muno nĩ bamĩrĩ cia Charlotte, no nĩ kũrĩ hingo ingĩhũthĩka.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Kũrĩ na kũrĩhio makĩria ũngĩkorwo ũkĩrĩtie athii eerĩ, kwoguo njĩra ĩno no ĩkorwo ĩrĩ ya goro makĩria ya ũrĩa kũbatiĩ.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica nĩkuo kũndũ kũrĩa kwĩ heho mũno thĩ ng'ima, na ĩthiũrũkĩirie South Pole.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Gũcera kũu kwĩ goro, kwendaga ucamba, kũngĩhanĩka tu mĩerinĩ ya summer Nov-Feb, na mũngĩcerio o Peninsula, islands na Ross Sea.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Andũ ngiri ciganona aruti wĩra nĩmaikaraga gũkũ ihinda rĩa summer thĩini wa kambĩ mĩrongo ĩtano; andũ anini nĩmaikaraga kũu ngina ihinda rĩa winter.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Antarctica thĩ nyũmũ ni njaraganu na ikaarirwo 2-3 km nĩ barabu.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Rĩmwe nĩkũrĩ aceri ngũthi a rĩerainĩ nĩmathiaga thĩ nyũmũ kũhaba irĩma na gũkinya Pole, ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo na kambĩ nene.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (kana Njĩra ya Gĩĩtwari) mũtoongoro wa kiromita ngiri ĩmwe na magana matandatũ kuuma Ceceni ya McMurdo ĩrĩa ĩrĩ Ross Sea nginya Pole.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ĩkoragwo na ira rĩkiindĩre na mĩatũka ĩiyũrĩtio na ĩkonanĩrĩrio na bendera.Ĩngĩgererwo tu nĩ tũraagita tũthondeketwo na njĩra ya mwanya, tũgĩkuuĩra sleds maguta na indo iria irabatarĩka.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Tũtũ tũtihotaga gũthiĩ narua mũno na kwoguo mũtoongoro ũcio ũbataraga gũthiũrũruka njĩra ndaaya ya Irĩma cia Transantarctic nĩguo gũkinya kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩu kĩaraganu.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Gitũmi kĩrĩa kĩnene kĩa mĩtino hĩndĩ ya heho nĩ njĩra nyoroku, tũcĩra twakĩtwo twa magũrũ (tũcĩra twa rwere-inĩ twa magũrũ) na mũno makĩria rĩambatĩro rĩa magũrũ.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ũrĩ ũndũ ũrĩa mũnini makĩria, nĩ ũrabatara iratũ irĩ na makinya marĩa maagĩrĩire. Iratũ cia hĩndĩ ya Ũrugarĩ kaingĩ nĩikoragwo irĩ nyoroku mũno mbarabu-inĩ na ira-inĩ, na iratũ imwe nditũ cia hĩndĩ ya heho no ndingiaru.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Mbano ciagĩrĩire ikorwo irĩ ndiku kũigana, mirimita ithano (nuthu inji) kana makĩria, na kĩndũ kĩria gĩcithondekete kĩororoe kũigana hĩndĩ ĩrĩa kũrĩ kũhehu.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Iratũ imwe nditũ ikoragwo na ciũma na nĩ kũrĩ mĩtambo ya kuongerera ciũma nĩ ũndũ wa kũrĩa kũnyororoku, yaaganĩrĩirwo na iratũ nyingĩ o na iratũ nditũ, nĩũndũ wa itende kana gĩtende na ikinya.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Itende ciagĩrĩire gũkorwo irĩ nguhĩ na njariĩ. Mũũthanga, kagoto kana cumbĩ (valcium chloride) kaingi nĩinyaganagio bara-inĩ kana tũcĩra-inĩ nĩguo kwongerera kũnyitana.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Mĩharũrũko ya ira na mahiga irĩma-inĩ ti ũndũ ũtoonekaga; mĩikũruko mĩinamu ingĩnyita tu o gũthiĩ gwa kahora mũno, no cianeneha makĩria nĩigũikũrũka ta mĩharũrũko ya ira na mahiga irĩma-inĩ.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Thĩĩna nĩ atĩ ira nĩrĩũmanagĩrĩra, na ũguo rĩbataraga kĩambĩrĩria kĩa mũthemba nĩguo rĩharũrũke, na ira rĩmwe rĩkĩharũrũka no rĩtũme rĩrĩa rĩngĩ rĩrũmĩrĩre.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Hĩndĩ ĩmwe ũndũ wa kĩambĩrĩria wa kĩhumo nĩ riũa rĩkĩhiũhia ira, na hĩndĩ ĩngĩ gũitĩka makĩria kwa ira, hĩndĩ ĩngĩ maũndũ mangĩ ma kĩ-ndũire, kaingĩ ma kuumana na andũ.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Tornado nĩ gĩtugĩ kĩa rĩera rĩhatĩke rĩkĩbĩrĩrĩka, rĩkĩgucagia rĩera rĩrĩa rĩthiũrũrũkĩirie na thĩ-inĩ kwerekera na igũrũ.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Iciaraga huho nene (kaingĩ mairo igana nginya magana meerĩ harĩ ithaa) na no cioe indo nditũ na igũrũ rĩera-inĩ, icikuuĩte o ũrĩa tornado ĩrathiĩ.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Ciambagĩrĩria ta mũberethi ũikũrũkĩte kuuma ihuhũkanio cia matu, na igatuĩka “tornadoes” rĩrĩa ciahutia thĩ.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Aheani a VPN (Virtual Private Network) cia mũndũ kĩũmbe nĩ njĩra njega mũno ya kweherera gũtuĩrio gĩ-ũteti o na IP-geofiltering ya kĩ-biacara.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Nĩ irĩ hinya gũkĩra web proxies nĩ ũndũ wa itũmi ciigana ũna: Nĩyerekagĩria internet traffic yothe njĩra-inĩ ingĩ, na kũrĩ http ike.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Kaingĩ iheanaga wariĩ wa mĩrũri irĩ igũrũ na ũtungata wa gĩkĩro kĩega makĩria. Nĩikoragwo ihingĩtwo wega na kwoguo nĩ hinya gũcithigana.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Kambũni cia moohoro kaingĩ nĩcihenanagia ũhoro-inĩ wĩgiĩ gĩtũmi kĩa ũndũ ũyũ, makiuga atĩ nĩ ya ‘kũgirĩrĩria ũici’.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Kwaria ma, codes cia icigo itirĩ ũndũ ihutanagia o na hanini na ũhoro wa gũthondeka kobĩ mũgarũ na watho; tondũ disk ikobetio gaturumo gwa gaturumo ĩkũruta wega mũtambo-inĩ o wothe o ta ĩrĩa ya kĩhumo.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Gĩtũmi kĩrĩa kĩo nĩ kũhe kambũni icio kwĩnyitĩra makĩria gwa thoko ciao; no ũhoro wa kuhiũria mbeca.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Tondũ thimũ ikĩhũrwo cierekagĩrio kũhĩtũkĩra rũrenda-inĩ, ndũrabatara kuhũthĩra kambũni ya thimũ ĩrĩ kũrĩa ũikaraga kana kũrĩa ũraceera.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Ningĩ gũtirĩ ũndũ wendekanaga wa atĩ wĩgĩĩre na namba ya kũu kuuma kũrĩ mũingĩ wa kũrĩa ũikaraga; no wĩĩgĩre na nenda cia kũnyitithanio na satellite ithaka-inĩ cia Chicken, Alaska na ũcagũre namba ĩrauga atĩ ũrĩ Arizona ya riũa.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Maita maingĩ, no nginya ũgũre namba mwanya ya kĩ-mabũrũri ĩrĩa ĩtĩkagĩria thimũ cia PSTN ikũhũrĩre. Kũrĩa namba yuumĩte nĩguo ũndũ ũrĩa ũrehage ngũũrani harĩ arĩa marakũhũũrĩra.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Real-time text translator apps-nĩ mũtaratara wa kũruta wĩra ũngĩhota hatarĩ gũtegũteithio gũtaũra icũnjĩ ng’ima cia maandĩko kuuma rũthiomi rũmwe nginya rũngĩ.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Ĩmwe ya mĩtaratara ĩno thĩ-inĩ wa gĩkundi gĩkĩ no ĩtaũre maandĩko marĩ thiomi-inĩ ng’eni imenyithia-inĩ na indo-inĩ ingĩ iria cionekaga thĩ-ĩno hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mũhũthĩrĩ oorota smartphone erekeirie indo icio.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Mĩtambo ya ũtaũri nĩ ĩthiĩte na mbere mũno, na rĩu kaingĩ niĩheanaga utaũri ũkuhĩrĩirie ũrĩa mwagĩrĩru (na ti muno ũkoragwo wĩ mũtukanĩre), no ũmenyereri mũna nĩwagĩrĩire, tondũ no  makorwo mataũkĩirwo ũũru biũ.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Mũtaratara umwe ũrĩa ũĩkaine mũno nĩ Google Taũra, urĩa wĩtĩkagĩria ũtaũri nja ya nenda thuutha wa gũcuurũria ũhoro ũrĩa ũrendekana wĩgiĩ rũthiomi.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Ũkĩhũthĩra mĩtaratara ya gwetha njĩra ya GPS ĩrĩ thĩ-inĩ wa smartphone yaku no ũkorwo ũrĩ ũndũ ũrĩa mũhũthũ mũno na ũraingĩrana wega wa gũcaria njĩra hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũrĩ nja ya bũrũri wa kwanyu.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: No kũhonokie mbeca handũ ha kũgũra mabu njerũ cia GPS, kana mũtambo wa GPS guo mwene kana gũkombora ũmwe kuuma kũrĩ kambũni cia gũkomborithia ngaari.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Ũngĩkorwo ndũrĩ na ũnyitithania wa data harĩ thimũ yaku, kana rĩrĩa ĩtarakinyĩrĩka, ũrũti wĩra wayo no ũkorwo wĩ mũkundeeru kana ũkaaga.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Gĩturi o gĩothe kĩa nduka kĩiyũrĩtio mĩthemba ĩrahĩngĩca ya kandi cia thimũ irĩhĩirwo iria ingĩhũthĩka thimũ-inĩ cia kũrĩhĩra kana thimũ iria ikoragwo kuo kaingĩ.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: O na harĩa kandi nyingĩ nĩ njega cia kũhũũra thimũ kũndũ guothe, imwe nĩ cia mwanya harĩ kũheana mathogora ma kũhũũra thimũ meega makĩrĩa kũrĩ ikundi imwe cia mabũrũri.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Kũhota gũkinyĩra mootungata maya kaingĩ nĩ kũhĩtũkĩra namba ya thimũ ĩtarĩ marĩhi ĩrĩa ĩngĩhũũrwo kuuma thimu-inĩ nyingĩ hatarĩ marĩhi.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Mawatho megiĩ ũhũũri mbica ũrĩa wonekaga mũno ningĩ nĩmahũthĩkaga harĩ kwoya thenema, na kwahoteka o na makĩria ya ũguo.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Kũngĩkorwo kũhũũra mbica ya kĩndũ gũtiĩtĩkĩrĩtio, rĩu ndwagĩrĩire o na gwĩciria ũhoro wa kuoya thenema yakĩo.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Ũngĩkorwo ũkĩhũthĩra drone, rora wega o mbere nĩ kĩĩ wĩtĩkĩrĩtio kũhũũra na nĩ marũa marĩkũ ma rũũtha kana marũa mangĩ makĩria marĩa marabatarĩka.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kũũmbũkia drone hakuhĩ na kĩhaaro kĩa ndege nĩ ũndũ ũkoragwo hĩndĩ ciothe ũtarĩ rĩĩciria rĩega, o na kũngĩkorwo ti mũgarũ na watho gĩcigo-inĩ kĩanyu.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Matukũ maya rũgendo rwa rĩera-inĩ ti kaingĩ rũgatagwo ĩmwe kwa ĩmwe kũhĩtũkĩra kambũni ya ndege hatarĩ kwamba gũcaria na kũringithania mathogora.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Hĩndĩ ĩmwe rũgendo o rũmwe no rũkorwo na mathogora ngũũrani mũno harĩ acokanĩrĩria na nĩ ũndũ ũrĩ uumithio kũringithania maumĩrĩra ma ũcaria na ningĩ kũrora rũrenda-inĩ rwa kambũni ya ndege yo nyene mbere ya kũgata.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: O na harĩa ũngĩaga kũbatara marũa ma ũthaami nĩ ũndũ wa iceera rĩa mabũrũri mamwe ũrĩ ta mũgendi kana mũndũ wa biacara, gũthiĩ kuo ta mũrutwo wa kĩ-mabũrũri kaingĩ kũbataraga ũikari mũraya makĩria gũkĩra gũthiĩ kuo o ta mũgendi wa hĩndĩ ĩmwe na ĩmwe.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Maita maingĩ, gũikara bũrũri-inĩ o wothe mũgeni kwa ihinda iraya mũno kũbataraga wĩgwatĩre marũa ma ũthaami o mbere-inĩ.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Marũa ma ũthami ma arutwo maita maingĩ makoragwo na mabataro ngũũrani na mĩtaratara ya ihoya kuuma kũrĩ mũgendi wa hĩndĩ ciothe kana marũa ma ũthaami ma kĩ-biacara.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Kũrĩ mabũrũri maingĩ, nĩũkũbatara irũa rĩa kwĩrĩrwo kuuma kũrĩ cukurũ ũrĩa ũrerirĩria gũthomera, na ningĩ ũira wa mbeca cia gwĩtungatĩra kwa ihinda rĩtanyihĩire mwaka wa mbere wa gĩthomo gĩaku.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Twĩria kũrĩ cukuru, na ningĩ rũhonge rwa ũthaami rwa bũrũri ũrĩa ũrenda gũthomera nĩguo ũgĩe na ũhoro makĩria wa marĩa marabatarĩka.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Tiga ũkorirwo ũrĩ mũbarũthi, kũruta wĩra mũrĩmo kaingĩ kuugaga atĩ no nginya ucokagie mathabu ma igoti rĩa mũcaara waku bũrũri-inĩ ũrĩa ũrĩ.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Igoti rĩa mũcaara rĩkoragwo rĩbangĩtwo na njĩra itigithũkanĩte mabũrũri-inĩ ngũũrani, na marĩhi ma igoti na ikĩro ciamo nĩ ngũũrani kuuma bũrũri-inĩ ũmwe nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Mabũrũri-inĩ mamwe marĩ na thirikari nene, ta United States na Canada, igoti rĩa mũcaara rĩrĩhagio harĩ thirikari nene na harĩ thirikari ya gĩcigo kĩnini, na kwoguo marihi na ikĩro no itigithũkane kuuma gĩcigo kĩmwe nginya kĩngĩ.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: O na harĩa ũthũũrimi wa ũthaami ũtakoragwo ho kana mũtaratara hĩndĩ ĩrĩa waakinya bũrũri wa kwanyu, ũramati wa igoti waahota gũkorwo ũrĩ na nguucanio nyingĩ.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Tigĩrĩra atĩ nĩũĩ kĩrĩa ũngĩhota kana ũtangĩhota kũrehe na uumbũre kĩndũ o gĩothe gĩkĩrũkĩte ithimi iria njĩtĩkĩrĩku kĩ-watho.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Njĩra ĩrĩa hũthũ mũno ya kwambĩrĩria biacara ya kwandĩka maũndũ megiĩ ũgendi nĩ kũnoora ũhĩgĩru waku thĩ-inĩ wa rũrenda rũhandĩku rwa waandĩki wa moohoro na ndeereti rwĩgiĩ ũgendi.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Waarĩkia kũiganĩra ũhoro-inĩ wa mubangĩre wa maandĩko na gũthondeka mahĩtia rũrenda-inĩ, ũcoke thuutha-inĩ, ũngĩhota uthondeke rũrenda rwaku.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Kwĩrutĩra hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũthiĩte rũgendo nĩ njĩra ya magegania ya kũrehe gĩtigithũkania na ti ũhoro tu na kũheana.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Gũtũũra na kwĩrutĩra ũrĩ bũrũri wa ũgeni nĩ njĩra ya magegania ya gũkinya kũmenya ũndũire ũrĩ na ngũũrani, gũcemania na andũ eerũ, gwĩthomera, kũgĩa na mwonere ũngĩ o na kũgĩa na ũũhĩgĩru mwerũ.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: No ĩkorwo ningĩ ĩrĩ njĩra njega ya kũgaatha mũbango wa mahũthĩro nĩguo gwĩtĩkĩria ũikari mũraya makĩrĩa wa kũndũ tondũ mawĩra maingĩ ma kwĩrutĩra nĩmaheanaga kanya ga gũkomaga kũu ũrarutĩra wĩra na anini ao nĩmarĩhaga kamũcaara kanini.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vikings maahũthĩrire njĩra cia maaĩ-inĩ cia andũ a Russia nĩguo maingĩre Black Sea na Caspian Sea. Icunjĩ imwe cia njĩra ici o na rĩu no ihũthĩke. Rora ũhotekeku wa kũbatarĩka kwa marũa ma mwanya ma kũheana rũũtha, marĩa mangĩkorwo marĩ hinya kũmona.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Canal ya White Sea–Baltic ĩnyitithanagia Iria rĩa Arctic na Iria rĩa Baltic, kũhĩtũkĩra Iria rĩa Onega, Iria rĩa Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, mũno makĩria na njĩra ya njũũĩ na maria.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Iria rĩa Onega o narĩo rĩnyitithanĩtio na Volga, na kwoguo kuuma Caspian Sea na kũhĩtũkĩra Russia no kũhoteke.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Gĩa na ũũma atĩ waakinya marinas maũndũ mothe nĩmakũmenyeka wega. Ũgũcemania na ahooi a ributi angĩ a tũtarũ na nĩmekũgayana ũhoro nawe.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Ũndũ ũrĩa mũnene nĩ atĩ nĩũgũkorwo ũgĩcuuria imenyithia cia kwĩranĩra ũteithio waku, gũthianga gĩcukĩro-inĩ, kwaranĩria na andũ magĩthambia merikabu ciao, kũgeria kwĩnyitithania na atwari a merikabu thĩ-inĩ wa baa, na mangĩ ta macio.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Geria kwaranĩria na andũ aingĩ o ũrĩa kũngĩhoteka. Thuutha wa kahinda kanini mũndũ wothe nĩekũmenya na akũhe cierekeria cia gatarũ karĩa karacaria mũndũ.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Wagĩrĩire ũthuure na kinyi ndege ĩrĩa Ĩrĩkũũmbũkagia Kaingĩ kuuma kũrĩ ngwatanĩro ya kambũni cia ndege.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: O na gũtuĩka wahota gwĩciria nĩ ũndũ ũtarabatara gwĩciria ũkĩĩnyitithania na kambũni ya ndege ĩrĩa ũũmbũkaga nayo kaingĩ, nĩwagĩrĩire ũmenye atĩ mĩeke ya gũtĩĩka ĩrĩa ĩraheanwo kaingĩ ĩkoragwo ĩrĩ ngũũrani na icukĩro ngũũrani cia ndege ciahota gũkorwo na ũtaana makĩria rungu rwa kambũni nguũrani cia ndege gwatanĩro-inĩ o ĩo.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Kambũni cia ndege ta Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines nĩciaramĩtie mũno mootungata mao gũthiĩ Africa, na nĩiheanaga ũnyitithania kũrĩ matũũra maingĩ manene ma Africa na mathogora mega gũkĩra kambũni ingĩ cia ndege cia Rũraya.
